lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 两人一前一后走到窗口前，埃莉诺隔着窗框扫过店里的货架。
lines.en: The two walk up to the window one after the other. Eleanor scans the shelves through the frame.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说今天带你过来，没食言吧？
lines.en: I said I'd bring you today. Kept my word, didn't I?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 一路上光听你念叨了。
lines.en: All I heard the whole way was you nagging.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 明明是你比我先拎起包出门的。
lines.en: You're the one who grabbed your bag and left before me.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我那是顺路出来买东西。
lines.en: I was heading out to buy things anyway.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 行行，顺路走到人家柜台前。
lines.en: Sure, sure. "Anyway" right up to his counter.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 原来你平时说的店就这么大一点儿。
lines.en: So the shop you always talk about is this tiny.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 站在窗前说话都像在贴着耳朵喊。
lines.en: Talking at the window feels like shouting in someone's ear.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……不对，我是不是嗓门太大了？
lines.en: ...Wait, am I being too loud?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你现在才发现啊。
lines.en: You're only noticing now?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我站这儿该干什么？
lines.en: So what am I supposed to do here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坐。
lines.en: Sit.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 可窗前就这一把旧凳子。
lines.en: But there's only one old stool by the window.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 另一把上面还堆着你的货呢。
lines.en: And the other one's piled with your stock.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他给了你凳子，你就先坐着。
lines.en: He gave you the stool. Just sit.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 货架二层压着一只盖子合不严的旧铜表。
lines.en: On the second shelf sits an old brass watch whose lid won't quite close.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 架上这些旧货都是别人拿来押的吗？
lines.en: Were all these old things on the shelves pawned?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 大多是。
lines.en: Mostly.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 要是没人来赎，就一直放着？
lines.en: And if nobody redeems them, they just stay here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 过日子总得换钱。
lines.en: People need money to get by.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 二层那只旧铜表能拿给我看看吗？
lines.en: Can I see that old brass watch on the second shelf?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （双手捧住铜表）拿在手里还挺沉的。
lines.en: (Holding the brass watch in both hands) It's heavier than it looks.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 表盖缝里这层擦不掉的黑灰是什么？
lines.en: What's this black grime in the lid's seam that won't wipe off?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 矿灰。
lines.en: Ore dust.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 内侧还刻着名字，边角都磨圆了。
lines.en: There's a name engraved inside, too. The edges are worn smooth.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这只表你卖不卖？
lines.en: Will you sell this watch?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不卖给你。
lines.en: Not to you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 为什么呀，我又没少给钱。
lines.en: Why not? It's not like I'd pay less.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你买回去只当谈资。
lines.en: You'd only buy it as a conversation piece.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 转头就锁进玻璃柜里了。
lines.en: Then lock it in a glass case the moment you got home.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 没说错，她真会这么干。
lines.en: He's not wrong. She really would.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这表不卖。
lines.en: This watch isn't for sale.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，我还没说要买呢！
lines.en: Hey, I haven't even said I'd buy it!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我就隔着窗户看一眼也不行吗？
lines.en: Can't I even take a look through the window?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你伸手看完了，下一句准是问价。
lines.en: Once you've had your look, your next line's the price.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 旧铜表被收进柜台下的抽屉里。
lines.en: The old brass watch goes into the drawer under the counter.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我才刚指了一下，你怎么就收起来了？
lines.en: I only pointed at it. Why'd you put it away?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他是怕你张口就拿钱砸下来。
lines.en: He's afraid you'll start throwing money at him.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我在你们眼里到底是什么人啊。
lines.en: What on earth do you two think I am?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 算了，我今天来是办正事的。
lines.en: Anyway, I came here on real business today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （咬住笔帽翻开小本子）我给埃莉诺列了张单子。
lines.en: (Biting her pen cap, flipping open a notebook) I made a list for Eleanor.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 先订两箱耐放的营养果送到她屋里。
lines.en: First, two crates of long-lasting Nutrifruit delivered to her place.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 再添四张厚毯子，夜里冷得要命。
lines.en: Then four thick blankets. The nights are freezing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还有你们那栋楼的楼梯，怎么连盏灯都没有？
lines.en: And the stairs in your building—why isn't there a single light?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 莉迪亚，把你的笔放下。
lines.en: Lydia, put your pen down.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 别往她那儿送。
lines.en: Don't send it to her place.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 连你也拦着我，这又不是乱花钱。
lines.en: Even you're stopping me? It's not like I'm wasting money.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 门口堆两箱营养果太扎眼。
lines.en: Two crates of Nutrifruit at her door would stand out.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 明天整栋楼都知道她收了谁的。
lines.en: By tomorrow the whole building would know whose gift she took.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 缺什么，直接问她本人。
lines.en: If she needs something, ask her yourself.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……好吧，是我没想那么多。
lines.en: ...Fine. I didn't think it through.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚合上小本子，塞回随身的挎包里。
lines.en: Lydia closes her little notebook and tucks it back into her shoulder bag.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 楼梯口至少得装盏灯，还要备几个灯泡。
lines.en: The stairwell needs a lamp at least, plus some spare bulbs.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你就算列满二十样，也进不了我的屋。
lines.en: List twenty things if you like. None of it's coming into my room.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你不让送货的人进，我就自己抱上去。
lines.en: If you won't let the delivery people in, I'll carry it up myself.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 反正一趟搬不完就分三趟搬。
lines.en: If it doesn't fit in one trip, I'll make three.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 小本子从窗口递进来，落到柜台面上。
lines.en: The little notebook is passed through the window and lands on the counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 上面的都不必送。
lines.en: None of this needs delivering.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那后半页写的那些呢？
lines.en: What about the stuff on the second half of the page?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 店里没有。
lines.en: Don't stock it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你这人怎么比埃莉诺还难说话。
lines.en: How are you even harder to talk to than Eleanor?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我不送箱子了，我去打听修楼梯灯的手续。
lines.en: Then no crates. I'll find out what it takes to fix the stairwell light.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 配给站和街上总有人管这事吧？
lines.en: Someone at the ration station or on the street must handle that, right?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……随你，别被人当肥羊宰就行。
lines.en: ...Suit yourself. Just don't let anyone fleece you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 行，修灯的事我不管你。
lines.en: Fine. I won't stop you on the light.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那可说好了，我改天还要来坐一下午。
lines.en: Then it's settled. I'm coming back to sit here a whole afternoon.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 窗前就一把凳子。
lines.en: There's only one stool by the window.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 里面还有一把。
lines.en: There's another inside.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 柜台下拖出另一把木凳，从窗口递到了旧凳子旁。
lines.en: Another wooden stool is dragged out from under the counter and passed through the window, next to the old one.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 木头硬邦邦的，算你有心啦。
lines.en: The wood's rock-hard, but I'll call it thoughtful.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 把你的包挪开，别占着我的地方。
lines.en: Move your bag. You're taking up my spot.

choices.description_en: Let her pick it up.
Not for sale, but let her look.

choices.label_en: Put it back under the counter
choices.description_en: Put the watch back in the drawer.
Let her finish writing the list.

choices.label_en: Tell her not to send anything
choices.description_en: Stop the arrangement.
Take the notebook and read it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚进门时两只手都空着，包带绕在腕上两圈。
lines.en: Lydia comes in with both hands empty, bag strap wound twice around her wrist.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 看见没有。空手。
lines.en: See? Empty hands.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我出门前把包倒过来抖了三下。
lines.en: Before I left, I turned my bag upside down and shook it three times.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坐。
lines.en: Sit.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 灯的事我问到底了。
lines.en: I got to the bottom of the light thing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 配给站推给房管，房管推给街道，街道让我去找修灯的老周。
lines.en: The ration station sent me to Housing, Housing sent me to the street office, and the street office told me to find Old Zhou, the repairman.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 三个地方，三张脸，说的是同一句：不归我管。
lines.en: Three places, three faces, all saying the same thing: not my problem.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我在上面从来没为一盏灯跑过路。
lines.en: Up there, I never had to run around for a single light.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 上面灯坏了，第二天就有人来换。
lines.en: Up there, if a light broke, someone came to replace it the next day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 老周说电线他有，灯泡他没有。
lines.en: Old Zhou says he has wire, but no bulbs.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我这有一盒。
lines.en: I've got a box here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.en: You—

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你早说啊。
lines.en: You could've said that sooner.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你才问。
lines.en: You just asked.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 多少钱。
lines.en: How much?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 一个三块，盒里六个，坏的挑出来。
lines.en: Three each. Six in the box. Pick out the bad ones.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你还挑。
lines.en: You even pick through them.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坏的装上，老周还得再爬一趟。
lines.en: Put a bad one in, Old Zhou has to climb up again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我等挑完。
lines.en: Then I'll wait till you're done picking.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把凳子往里挪了半尺，坐下，两只手放在膝上。
lines.en: She drags the stool half a foot closer, sits, and puts both hands on her knees.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我今天来是想说——
lines.en: I came today because I wanted to say—

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 门被顶开，两个人一前一后进来，前头那个把帽子摘了。
lines.en: The door is shoved open. Two men come in one after the other. The one in front takes off his hat.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 老板。
lines.en: Boss.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 收东西？
lines.en: You buy things?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 收。
lines.en: I buy.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 那她的东西，你也收？
lines.en: Then her stuff—you buy that too?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他眼睛落在莉迪亚的腕子上，没有挪开。
lines.en: His eyes land on Lydia's wrist and stay there.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我没什么要卖的。
lines.en: I've got nothing to sell.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 手上那个。
lines.en: The thing on your hand.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这个不卖。
lines.en: That's not for sale.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 不卖也行。
lines.en: Don't sell, then.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 那咱们算另一笔。
lines.en: Then we settle another bill.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 生面孔在这条街上走动，一个月二十。
lines.en: New face on this street. Twenty a month.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 二十信用点。
lines.en: Twenty credits.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 二十。
lines.en: Twenty.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你知道二十信用点在上面能买什么吗。
lines.en: You know what twenty credits buys up there?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 不知道。
lines.en: No.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你讲给我听。
lines.en: Tell me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他往前半步，手搭在柜沿，离那只镯子剩一指。
lines.en: He steps half a pace closer, hand on the counter edge, one finger from the bracelet.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主从柜台后绕出来，站在两张脸中间。
lines.en: The shopkeeper comes around from behind the counter and stands between them.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 手拿开。
lines.en: Hands off.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你谁。
lines.en: Who are you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 店主。
lines.en: The shopkeeper.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 那正好，你这店一并算。
lines.en: Good. Your shop goes on the bill too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 算多少。
lines.en: How much.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 五十。
lines.en: Fifty.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我这店一个月进不来五十。
lines.en: My shop doesn't bring in fifty a month.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 那就抵货。
lines.en: Then pay in goods.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 行。
lines.en: All right.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.en: ...All right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 柜台里六只灯泡，一把断了三齿的梳子，半罐钉子。
lines.en: In the counter: six bulbs, a comb missing three teeth, half a can of nails.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你搬。
lines.en: You carry it.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你当我是来要饭的。
lines.en: You think I'm here to beg?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我在跟你谈。
lines.en: I'm talking business.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你要钱，我这没有。你要货，我称给你。
lines.en: You want money, I don't have it. You want goods, I'll weigh them for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 他真有个秤。
lines.en: He actually has a scale.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 闭嘴。
lines.en: Shut up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你要卖什么。
lines.en: What are you selling?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 我不卖东西。
lines.en: I'm not selling anything.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那你站错地方了。
lines.en: Then you're standing in the wrong place.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我这店只做买卖。
lines.en: This shop's just business.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: ……你跟我讲买卖。
lines.en: ...You're talking business to me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 他跟你讲规矩。
lines.en: He's telling you the rules.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 规矩值几个钱。
lines.en: What're rules worth?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他把帽子往柜上一丢，手跟着伸过去。
lines.en: He tosses his hat onto the counter and reaches out a hand.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主绕过去，把门拉到最大，让巷子的光进来。
lines.en: The shopkeeper goes around and pulls the door wide, letting the alley light in.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 出去说。
lines.en: Outside.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 我进来坐坐也不行。
lines.en: So I can't even come in and sit?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不做你的生意。
lines.en: Not doing business with you.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 这条街上，说不做生意的人不多。
lines.en: Not many on this street say no to business.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 现在多一个。
lines.en: Now there's one more.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他把门往回推。
lines.en: He pushes the door back.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 那我偏要买。
lines.en: Then I'm buying anyway.

blocks.label_en: The Hand Closes on the Bracelet

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他的手落下去，扣住那只戴镯子的腕子。
lines.en: His hand comes down and grabs the wrist with the bracelet.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 松手。
lines.en: Let go.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 镯子先押我这儿，你回去拿钱。
lines.en: Bracelet stays with me. Go get the money.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 笔尖扎进他手背，她整个人跟着往前送了一步。
lines.en: The pen tip stabs into the back of his hand. She steps forward with it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他缩手，退到门边，把帽子捏扁了。
lines.en: He jerks his hand back, backs to the door, and crushes his hat.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你个——
lines.en: You—

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我数三下。
lines.en: I'm counting to three.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 一。
lines.en: One.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 这条街就这么长。
lines.en: This street's only so long.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你走到头，还得回来。
lines.en: You go to the end, you still gotta come back.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 门被摔上，玻璃抖了两下才停。
lines.en: The door slams. The glass shakes twice before it stops.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……笔弯了。
lines.en: ...The pen's bent.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我扎得不轻吧。
lines.en: I stabbed him pretty hard, didn't I?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 他手背上全是黑的，是不是笔芯漏了。
lines.en: His hand was all black. Did the pen leak?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 是血。
lines.en: It's blood.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把笔搁在柜台上，指尖在裤缝上蹭了两下。
lines.en: She sets the pen on the counter and wipes her fingertips twice on her pant seam.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我刚才一点都不怕。
lines.en: I wasn't scared at all back there.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 现在开始怕了。
lines.en: Starting to be now.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 怕就坐一会儿。
lines.en: Scared? Sit a minute.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 他们认得我的镯子。
lines.en: They know my bracelet.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我上回戴着它在这条街上走了一整圈。
lines.en: Last time I walked this whole street wearing it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我还在巷口停下来，看了半天热闹。
lines.en: I even stopped at the corner and watched the fuss for ages.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这条街上没什么热闹。
lines.en: There's no fuss on this street.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那我记错了。
lines.en: ...Then I remembered wrong.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我当时在想别的事。
lines.en: I was thinking about something else.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 二十不是冲你来的。
lines.en: Twenty isn't after you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那是冲谁。
lines.en: Then who?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 冲这条街。谁生，谁就好要。
lines.en: The street. New faces are easy to squeeze.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 所以我空手来也错了。
lines.en: So coming empty-handed was a mistake too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你来了。
lines.en: You came.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……这话听着像夸人。
lines.en: ...That sounded like a compliment.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 是句实话。
lines.en: It's the truth.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 灯泡我照买。六个我都要，坏的我也要。
lines.en: I'm still buying the bulbs. All six. Broken ones too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坏的没用。
lines.en: Broken ones are useless.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我拿去给老周，让他看看我这人多难缠。
lines.en: I'll take them to Old Zhou. Show him how difficult I can be.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把钱一张一张数在柜面上，数完把钱推过来，没推远。
lines.en: She counts the money onto the counter, bill by bill. Then pushes it over. Not far.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你能送我出去吗。
lines.en: Can you walk me out?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 就送到巷口。
lines.en: Just to the corner.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 能。
lines.en: I can.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他把柜面收进抽屉，锁扣按了两下。
lines.en: He sweeps the counter into the drawer. Presses the lock twice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 巷子对面有人靠着墙站，见他们出来，转身走了。
lines.en: Across the alley, someone leans against the wall. Sees them come out. Turns and walks away.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那个人……
lines.en: That person...

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看见了。
lines.en: Saw them.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 送到这儿就行。
lines.en: Here's far enough.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我认得路。
lines.en: I know the way.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她走出去十几步，回头看了一下，才拐弯。
lines.en: She walks a dozen steps, glances back once, then turns the corner.

choices.description_zh: 挡在莉迪亚和打手之间。
choices.description_en: Put yourself between Lydia and the thug.
Turn it back into a transaction.

choices.label_en: Open the door and ask him out
choices.description_en: Let the alley light in.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺把布袋搁在柜角，袋口露出两截铜管。
lines.en: Eleanor sets the cloth bag on the corner of the counter. Two lengths of copper pipe stick out of the top.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 称。
lines.en: Weigh it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 哪来的。
lines.en: Where's it from?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 七号楼后头，旧管子，看门的老头点了头。
lines.en: Behind Building Seven. Old pipes. The old man at the gate nodded.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我拆的时候他站在旁边看，没说不许。
lines.en: He stood there watching while I pulled them out. Didn't say no.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 铜的，三斤二。
lines.en: Copper. Three pounds two.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 值多少。
lines.en: What's it worth?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 三十五。
lines.en: Thirty-five.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 上次那样的管子，你给二十。
lines.en: Last time, pipes like these, you gave me twenty.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 上次那截里灌了水泥。
lines.en: Last time that piece was packed with cement.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……这回我敲过了。
lines.en: …I knocked on these ones.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 敲过的就三十五。
lines.en: Knocked on, it's thirty-five.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚站在门边，纸盒夹在腋下，眼睛看着巷子。
lines.en: Lydia stands by the door, a paper box under her arm, eyes on the alley.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 她在门口站了一刻钟。
lines.en: She's been at the door a quarter hour.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看见了。
lines.en: Saw her.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 她说这条街上有人盯着她的镯子。
lines.en: She says someone on this street is watching her bracelet.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 她说的时候手一直在抖，抖完还笑。
lines.en: Her hands shook the whole time she said it. Then she laughed.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你今天来做什么。
lines.en: What'd you come here for today?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我来结灯泡的账。
lines.en: I came to settle the bulb bill.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 顺便看看你门后那根杠子还在不在。
lines.en: And to see if that bar's still behind your door.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 在。
lines.en: It is.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那我就多坐一会儿。
lines.en: Then I'll sit a while longer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 巷口进来六个人，走得不快，把门口站满。
lines.en: Six men come in from the alley mouth. Not fast. They fill the doorway.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 老板。
lines.en: Boss.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 上回扎我那个，还在不在。
lines.en: The one who stuck me last time. Still here?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 在。
lines.en: Still here.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 我没问你。
lines.en: I wasn't asking you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我答了。
lines.en: I answered anyway.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他笑了一声。
lines.en: He laughs once.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 今天不是二十的事了。
lines.en: Today it's not about twenty.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 两千。
lines.en: Two thousand.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 什么东西两千。
lines.en: Two thousand for what?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 两个人。
lines.en: Two people.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你要绑人。
lines.en: You're kidnapping people.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 我说请。
lines.en: I said please.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你手上拿的什么。
lines.en: What's that in your hand?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他手边垂着一卷绳，绳头在地上拖着。
lines.en: A coil of rope hangs by his hand, its end dragging on the floor.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 上面的人为一个女儿掏两千，不难。
lines.en: People upstairs pay two thousand for a daughter. Not hard.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 不掏也行，人先跟我们走一趟，家里自己会想通。
lines.en: Or they don't pay. She comes with us first. Family will come around.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我母亲被带走那天，来的人也这么说。
lines.en: The men who took my mother said the same thing.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 先叫名字，再说请。
lines.en: Say a name first. Then please.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你母亲是谁。
lines.en: Who's your mother?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 不关你的事。
lines.en: None of your business.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她俩不出这个门。
lines.en: They're not going out that door.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你说了不算。
lines.en: You don't get a say.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 两个人绕到柜台两侧，把里头那点路堵住。
lines.en: Two men move around both sides of the counter and block the way inside.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 一只手推在货架上，架子连着货一起往外倒。
lines.en: A hand shoves the shelf; shelf and goods spill outward.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主后背撞上柜角，额角磕在横梁的包铁上。
lines.en: The shopkeeper's back hits the counter corner; forehead cracks against the iron band on the beam.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 手拿开！
lines.en: Hands off!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她抽出门后那根木杠，横着一头顶在那人肋上。
lines.en: She yanks the wooden bar from behind the door and jams one end into the man's ribs.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 把杠子夺了。
lines.en: Take the bar.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 杠子被两只手扭住，她被带得撞在门框上，肩先着地。
lines.en: Two hands wrench the bar away. She's pulled into the doorframe and lands on her shoulder.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 莉迪亚——门！
lines.en: Lydia—the door!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚把门拉开，冲着巷子喊了两声。
lines.en: Lydia pulls the door open and shouts twice into the alley.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 巷子两头，卷帘一扇接一扇响起来。
lines.en: At both ends of the alley, roller shutters clatter up one after another.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他抓起架子上那只旧表。
lines.en: He grabs the old watch from the shelf.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 走。
lines.en: Go.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 一只脚踩在架子底下，空血袋裂了一道口。
lines.en: A foot stamps down under the shelf; an empty blood bag splits open.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 脚步顺着巷子跑远，卷帘又落回去。
lines.en: Footsteps run off down the alley. The shutters drop back down.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你的头。
lines.en: Your head.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先看门。
lines.en: Door first.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 门歪了。
lines.en: The door's crooked.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 歪了能修。
lines.en: Crooked can be fixed.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你额头上在往下滴。
lines.en: Your forehead's dripping.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 地我扫。
lines.en: I'll sweep the floor.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 巷口喇叭：本街入夜后禁止聚众逗留，违者登记。
lines.en: Loudspeaker at the alley mouth: No loitering in groups on this street after dark. Violators will be registered.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚从巷子里回来，手里捏着一张写了两行字的纸。
lines.en: Lydia comes back from the alley, holding a paper with two lines written on it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 问了三家。
lines.en: I asked at three places.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 两家不开门。一家开门，是个老太太。
lines.en: Two wouldn't open. One did—an old lady.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说这伙人上个月在码头那边带走过一个孩子。
lines.en: She said this bunch took a kid from over by the docks last month.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 孩子家里凑了钱，第三天放回来了。
lines.en: The family scraped the money together. The kid was back on the third day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说这话的时候，门只开了一条缝。
lines.en: When she said it, the door was only open a crack.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说到一半，她让我别再问了。
lines.en: Halfway through, she told me to stop asking.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 纸上是什么。
lines.en: What's on the paper.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说的。
lines.en: What she said.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我怕我记错。
lines.en: I was afraid I'd get it wrong.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把纸拍在柜台上。
lines.en: She slaps the paper on the counter.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我明天去治安部。
lines.en: I'm going to the Watch office tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 治安部要收登记费。
lines.en: The Watch charges a filing fee.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我出。
lines.en: I'll pay.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我出不起你那份人情。
lines.en: I can't afford to owe you that favor.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这跟人情有什么关系。
lines.en: What's that got to do with favors?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你出了钱，这事就成了你的事。
lines.en: You pay, and this becomes your business.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 它本来就是我的事！
lines.en: It was my business to begin with!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……他们看的是我的镯子。
lines.en: ...It was my bracelet they were looking at.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我要是把它摘下来收进袖子，那天根本没这回事。
lines.en: If I'd taken it off and tucked it in my sleeve, none of this would've happened that day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我上回还站在这儿笑你这屋子没窗。
lines.en: Last time I stood right here and laughed about your place having no windows.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我笑的时候，他们大概正蹲在巷口看我。
lines.en: While I was laughing, they were probably crouched at the alley mouth watching me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他们不是今天才蹲的。
lines.en: They didn't start crouching there today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你早知道？
lines.en: You knew?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 知道有人在看。不知道是六个。
lines.en: I knew someone was watching. Didn't know there were six.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那你为什么不早说。
lines.en: Then why didn't you say so?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说了你就不来了。
lines.en: You wouldn't have come.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我还真就不来了。
lines.en: You're right. I wouldn't have.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 所以你宁可我挨这一下。
lines.en: So you'd rather I take that hit.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我宁可得罪你。
lines.en: I'd rather have you mad at me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺从后头找了块湿布，按在他额角上。
lines.en: Eleanor found a wet cloth in the back and pressed it to the side of his forehead.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 两千。
lines.en: Two thousand.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 他们报得出这个数，说明早就问过。
lines.en: They could name that number. Means they already asked.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 问我住哪一栋，问我家几口人。
lines.en: Asked which building I live in. How many people in my family.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 问的是这店能出多少。
lines.en: They asked what this shop can pay.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那也一样。
lines.en: Same thing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 去报。报完回来。
lines.en: Go report it. Come back after.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你不拦我。
lines.en: You're not stopping me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 拦不住。
lines.en: Can't.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她出去了一趟，半个钟头后回来，纸还在手里。
lines.en: She went out. Came back half an hour later, paper still in her hand.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 窗口说要有登记，要有见证人。
lines.en: The window said I need a registration. And a witness.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 见证人得是这条街上的人。
lines.en: Witness has to be from this street.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这条街上没人肯签。
lines.en: Nobody on this street will sign.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主蹲下去，把散在地上的旧货一件一件码回箱子。
lines.en: The shopkeeper crouched down and stacked the old goods scattered on the floor back into the box, one by one.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 报案的事明天再说。
lines.en: The report can wait till tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 明天他们可能就来了。
lines.en: Tomorrow they might be here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就明天再说。
lines.en: Then we deal with it tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 现在把这个捡起来。
lines.en: Now pick this up.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 捡起来有什么用。
lines.en: What's the point of picking it up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 明早要开门。
lines.en: We open in the morning.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她蹲下去，先拎起那只被踩裂的血袋，抖了两下。
lines.en: She crouched down, picked up the blood bag cracked underfoot first, and shook it twice.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这个还能收吗。
lines.en: Can this still be sold?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 收不了。
lines.en: Can't take it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那他来赎怎么办。
lines.en: Then what if he comes to redeem it?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他不来。
lines.en: He won't.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你怎么知道。
lines.en: How do you know.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他要是来，早来了。
lines.en: If he were coming, he'd be here already.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把血袋卷起来，卷成一团，两只手按着不放。
lines.en: She rolls up the blood bag, into a ball, and holds it down with both hands.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我明天带两百来。
lines.en: I'll bring two hundred tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不要。
lines.en: Don't.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不是给你的。
lines.en: It's not for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 是我把这屋子弄成这样，我赔。
lines.en: I'm the one who wrecked this room. I pay.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 两百赔不了这只表。
lines.en: Two hundred won't cover the watch.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那表很贵？
lines.en: ...That watch is expensive?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 押的。
lines.en: It's collateral.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 押的东西你给卖了不就完了。
lines.en: Then just sell the collateral and be done.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我没卖过押品。
lines.en: I don't sell collateral.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她站起来。
lines.en: She stands up.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 行。那你说个数。
lines.en: Fine. Then name a number.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 现在不说。
lines.en: Not now.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你这人。
lines.en: You're something.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你连让我难受一下都不许。
lines.en: You won't even let me feel bad about it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把纸折了两折，捏在手里，站到门口那块亮起来的地方。
lines.en: She folds the paper twice, holds it, and steps into the light at the door.

blocks.label_en: Tell Her to Hide the Bracelet

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 把镯子收起来。别在这条街上戴。
lines.en: Put the bracelet away. Don't wear it on this street.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你也觉得是我招来的。
lines.en: So you think I brought them here too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我是说，别让人看见。
lines.en: I'm saying don't let anyone see it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把镯子褪下来，握了一会儿，塞进衣袋。
lines.en: She slips the bracelet off, holds it a moment, and shoves it in her pocket.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 戴着它的时候，我觉得它是我外婆的。
lines.en: When I wear it, I feel like it's my grandmother's.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 门轴歪了半寸，关不严，风从缝里钻进来。
lines.en: The hinge is off half an inch. The door won't shut. Wind comes through the gap.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺把布拿开看了一眼。
lines.en: Eleanor pulls the cloth away and looks.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 口子不深。
lines.en: Not deep.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 会留疤。
lines.en: It'll scar.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 留就留。
lines.en: Let it scar.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你倒是好说话。
lines.en: You're awfully agreeable.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 刚才那一下偏两指，你这只眼就废了。
lines.en: That last one was two fingers off. You'd have lost that eye.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没偏。
lines.en: It wasn't off.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那是运气，不是本事。
lines.en: That's luck, not skill.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你手里连根铁条都没有，你就往中间站。
lines.en: You didn't even have an iron bar, and you stood in the middle.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我有柜台。
lines.en: I had the counter.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 柜台倒了。
lines.en: The counter fell.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 倒了也还在。
lines.en: Fell or not, it's still there.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那只表呢。
lines.en: And the watch?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 被拿走了。
lines.en: It was taken.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 押的？
lines.en: Pawned?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 押的。
lines.en: Pawned.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 押多久了。
lines.en: How long has it been pawned?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 一年零三个月。
lines.en: A year and three months.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 人不来赎，本来归你。
lines.en: If he doesn't come to redeem it, it's yours.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他上个月来过一趟。
lines.en: He came by last month.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……来过？
lines.en: …He came?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 站在门口，没进来。
lines.en: Stood at the door. Didn't come in.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说再宽两个月。
lines.en: Asked for two more months.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你怎么说的。
lines.en: What did you say?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我说东西在。
lines.en: I said it was here.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 现在不在了。
lines.en: It's not here now.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我去找。
lines.en: I'll go find it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 找谁。
lines.en: Find who?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 找那条巷子。
lines.en: That alley.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你一个人。
lines.en: You're going alone.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 一个人。
lines.en: Alone.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你戴着这一脑袋血去。
lines.en: You're going with all that blood on your head.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他们六个，认得出你。
lines.en: Six of them. They know your face.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他们认得的是柜台。
lines.en: They know the counter.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你也是柜台？
lines.en: You're a counter too?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 算是。
lines.en: Something like that.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把布重新按回去，用力了一点。
lines.en: She presses the cloth back down. A little harder.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 坐下。
lines.en: Sit.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 站着就行。
lines.en: I'm fine standing.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 坐下。血流到脖子里了。
lines.en: Sit. Blood's running down your neck.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他坐下，凳子腿在砖上磨了一声。
lines.en: He sits. The stool leg scrapes on the brick.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我以前在书上看到过一种说法，说人在这种时候会发昏。
lines.en: I read something in a book once. That people go lightheaded at a time like this.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我看你没有。
lines.en: You don't look it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 发昏也没用。
lines.en: Going lightheaded wouldn't help.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 没用也得发。
lines.en: You'd still do it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我母亲被带走那天，我在门口站到天黑。
lines.en: The day they took my mother, I stood in the doorway till dark.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那会儿我什么都做不了。
lines.en: I couldn't do anything then.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 今天我顶了他一下。
lines.en: Today I pushed back at him.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 顶得不好，被夺了。
lines.en: Not well. He took it off me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 顶到了。
lines.en: You landed it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……顶到了。
lines.en: ...I landed it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他缩了一下，我看见了。
lines.en: He flinched. I saw it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚从门口回来，把锤子搁在柜台上，掌心一层灰。
lines.en: Lydia comes back from the door, sets the hammer on the counter. Dust on her palm.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 门钉上了？
lines.en: Door nailed shut?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 钉了两块板。
lines.en: Two boards.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 明天还得开。
lines.en: It has to open tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 开了再说。
lines.en: We'll see when it opens.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把那张纸从口袋里掏出来，放在柜面上，压平。
lines.en: She pulls the paper out of her pocket, puts it on the counter, flattens it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 这纸我拿着。
lines.en: I'll hold on to the paper.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 上面是我写的字。
lines.en: That's my writing on it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我知道。
lines.en: I know.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 明天我早来。
lines.en: I'll come early tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 随你。
lines.en: Suit yourself.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 不是随你。是我来。
lines.en: Not suit yourself. I'm doing it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把纸折好塞进衣袋，伸手把歪掉的那扇门往上抬了抬。
lines.en: She folds the paper, tucks it in her pocket, and lifts the crooked door back up.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 这门抬不平了。
lines.en: This door won't sit straight anymore.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 能挡风。
lines.en: It blocks the wind.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 挡不住人。
lines.en: It won't block people.

choices.description_en: Let her go to Security.
Salvage what can be salvaged.

choices.label_en: Tell her to hide the bracelet
choices.description_en: Stop letting it show.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 天刚亮，埃莉诺站在门外，脚边放着工具布袋，手里捏着起子和两枚螺丝。
lines.en: Daybreak. Eleanor stands outside the door. A tool bag at her feet. A screwdriver and two screws in her hand.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你说早来，我就早来。
lines.en: You said come early. So I came early.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我没说。
lines.en: I didn't say that.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我说的。一样。
lines.en: I said it. Same thing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这是从你柜子底下翻的，别跟我收钱。
lines.en: Found these under your counter. Don't charge me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 本来就是我的。
lines.en: They were mine to begin with.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 所以才不收。
lines.en: That's why I'm not charging.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主托住门板，她蹲下去拧螺丝，起子打滑了两回。
lines.en: The shopkeeper holds the door panel up. She crouches and turns the screws. The screwdriver slips twice.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这螺丝口都秃了。谁装的。
lines.en: These screw heads are stripped. Who put these in.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我。
lines.en: Me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……行吧，装得还算结实。
lines.en: ...Fine. It's holding, at least.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再抬高一点。好，别动。
lines.en: A little higher. Good. Hold still.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 最后一圈拧紧，门合上只剩一道缝。她把起子放回布袋，捏着袋口。
lines.en: The last turn goes tight. The door closes to a crack. She puts the screwdriver back in the bag and grips it by the top.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 能关了。
lines.en: It'll close now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你额头还没结好痂，抬东西别使那么大劲。
lines.en: Your forehead's not even scabbed over. Don't lift so hard.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 门比头沉。
lines.en: The door's heavier than my head.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 呵，你倒是会比。
lines.en: Hah. You'll compare anything.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂。
lines.en: Hey.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那天那根杠子被他们夺走以后，
lines.en: That day, after they got the bar out of my hands—

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我以为下一下就该落到我身上。
lines.en: I thought the next one was landing on me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 结果没有。你站过来了。
lines.en: It didn't. You stepped in front.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 柜台在那儿。
lines.en: The counter was right there.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少来。柜台倒了，你还站着。
lines.en: Cut it out. The counter went down. You stayed standing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我从小到大，除了母亲，没人这样挡在我前面。
lines.en: Growing up, no one stood in front of me like that. Except my mother.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上面那些人只会说“小姐别怕”，然后往后退。
lines.en: The people above us just say "don't be scared, miss," and step back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你什么都不说，往前走。
lines.en: You say nothing. You step forward.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你这个人，靠得住。
lines.en: You. You're solid.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我……喜欢你。就这样。
lines.en: I... like you. That's all.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主搁下螺丝盒，站起来。
lines.en: The shopkeeper sets down the screw box and stands.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 埃莉诺——
lines.en: Eleanor—

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 埃莉诺。
lines.en: Eleanor.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 叫名字也不行。我还没说完——不对，说完了。
lines.en: Saying my name doesn't work either. I wasn't done— no. I'm done.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主倒了杯水推过去，她盯着杯沿，没接。
lines.en: The shopkeeper pours a cup of water and pushes it over. She stares at the rim. Doesn't take it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你就拿这个回我？荒谬。
lines.en: That's your answer? Ridiculous.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……水我不喝。
lines.en: ...I'm not drinking the water.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她往前一步，踮脚在他脸侧碰了一下，很快退开。
lines.en: She steps forward, rises on her toes, touches his cheek. Then pulls back fast.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别说。今天别说。
lines.en: Don't say it. Not today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 账我记着。
lines.en: I'm keeping count.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她拎起布袋推开门，门轴响了一声，人已经拐出巷口。
lines.en: She picks up her cloth bag and pushes the door open. The hinge creaks. She's already around the corner.

choices.label_en: Put the work down and stand
choices.description_en: Stand up and let her finish.
Stop her with her name.
Give her a moment.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚进门先看了一眼门轴，又低头看自己的鞋尖。
lines.en: Lydia comes in, glances at the door hinge, then down at her own shoe tips.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 门修好了？谁修的？你？
lines.en: The door's fixed? Who fixed it? You?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 两个人修的。
lines.en: Took two of us.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好啊，那我来晚了，连根钉子都没帮上。
lines.en: Great. So I'm late. Didn't even get to hand over a nail.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 治安部那边我又去问了一趟。
lines.en: I stopped by the Watch office again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 登记的人说要等，等多久也不说。
lines.en: The clerk said wait. Wouldn't say how long.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 表的事……我还在想办法，你别催我。
lines.en: The watch... I'm still working on it. Don't rush me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没催。
lines.en: Not rushing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对，你从来不催，所以我更急。
lines.en: Right. You never rush me. That's why I'm worse.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把镯子往腕子里推了推，手指在柜面上敲了三下。
lines.en: She pushes her bracelet up her wrist and taps the counter three times.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我今天来，是想谈笔生意。
lines.en: I came here today to talk business.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你就说——你多少钱？
lines.en: Just tell me— how much are you?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 什么多少钱。
lines.en: How much am I what.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你。整个人。我买下来，省得你天天在这儿挨人砸。
lines.en: You. All of you. I'll buy you. Then you won't get smashed up here every day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……不对，等等，这话说出来怎么这么难听。
lines.en: ...No. Wait. Why does that sound so bad out loud.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我不卖人。
lines.en: I don't sell people.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 自己也不卖。
lines.en: Including myself.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我知道。我又不是来……我就是嘴快。
lines.en: I know. I'm not here to— I just talk fast.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那换一个。我不买你，我买你一天。
lines.en: Then different. I won't buy you. I'll buy one day of you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你想要什么。直说。
lines.en: What do you want. Say it straight.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 直说我就说不出来了。你让我先绕一下。
lines.en: Straight, and I can't say it. Let me go around first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我不买你。买你一天不营业，行不行。
lines.en: I'm not buying you. I'm buying one day you're closed. Okay?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 墙上有价签。上面没有我。
lines.en: There are price tags on the wall. I'm not on them.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，你这人连拒绝都按货架来。
lines.en: Oh, you even reject people by the shelf.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那换一个，货架上没有的——你一天。
lines.en: Then something else. Not on the shelf—one day of you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 一天不开门，你这店少进多少，我补多少。
lines.en: One day closed. Whatever your shop misses, I'll cover it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 一天进不了多少。
lines.en: A day doesn't bring in much.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我按门坏了那几天算，按货倒了那天算。两千。
lines.en: Then I'll go by those days the door was broken, and the day the goods fell over. Two thousand.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 太多。
lines.en: Too much.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 是我自己的钱，不是家里的。
lines.en: It's my own money. Not the family's.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 是停业的钱，别的什么都不是。
lines.en: It's money for closing. Nothing else.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你要是觉得我在买别的，你现在就说，我拿回去。
lines.en: If you think I'm buying something else, say it now, and I'll take it back.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主看了她一会儿。
lines.en: The shopkeeper looked at her for a moment.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 一天。
lines.en: One day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……真的？你别笑。
lines.en: ...Really? Don't laugh.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没笑。
lines.en: Not laughing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那可说好了。
lines.en: Then it's settled.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 明天一早，你别开门做生意，开门等我。
lines.en: First thing tomorrow, don't open for business—open the door and wait for me.

choices.label_en: Say you do not sell people
choices.description_en: Refuse to be bought.
Make her say it plainly.
Refuse her with the shelf.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 门一开，莉迪亚已经站在外头，头发别得很整齐。
lines.en: The door opened. Lydia was already outside, her hair pinned neat.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我来早了。没吵醒你吧。
lines.en: I'm early. Didn't wake you, did I?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 醒着。
lines.en: Awake.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好看吗？你就说一句，说完我就不问了。
lines.en: Do I look good? Just say one thing, and I won't ask again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好看。
lines.en: You look good.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你说得也太快了。
lines.en: ...You said that way too fast.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天这店归我。
lines.en: This shop's mine today.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她侧身走进来。
lines.en: She stepped in sideways.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 门关上了。
lines.en: The door closed.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店门开着，莉迪亚坐在柜台外那张凳子上。
lines.en: The shop door was open. Lydia sat on the stool outside the counter.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我想了一路，下回该轮到我带吃的。
lines.en: I thought about it the whole way. Next time it's my turn to bring food.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你别说不要，我已经想好了。
lines.en: Don't say no. I've already decided.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 有件事你该知道。
lines.en: There's something you should know.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好啊，你说。
lines.en: All right. Tell me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 埃莉诺前几天来过。门是她修的。
lines.en: Eleanor came by a few days ago. She fixed the door.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她跟我说了她的心思。在你之前。
lines.en: She told me how she feels. Before you did.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……在我之前。
lines.en: ...Before me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说了什么——不，你别告诉我。那是她的话。
lines.en: What did she say— no, don't tell me. Those are her words.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我没打算替她说。
lines.en: I wasn't going to speak for her.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她站起来，凳子往后挪了半尺，手按在柜沿上没松。
lines.en: She stands. The stool scrapes back half a foot. Her hand stays flat on the counter.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我还以为我挺会安排的。
lines.en: I thought I was good at planning things.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 结果我连她走在我前面都不知道。
lines.en: Turns out I didn't even know she'd gotten ahead of me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对不起。
lines.en: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我不该用钱绕着弯来要你一天，也不该瞒着她。
lines.en: I shouldn't have used money to dance around asking for your day. And I shouldn't have kept it from her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 钱你留着，那是你关门的钱，跟这事没关系。
lines.en: Keep the money. That's for closing your shop. Nothing to do with this.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 知道。
lines.en: I know.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这事我不会当成秘密。
lines.en: I won't make this a secret.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 从今天起，我不再私下来买你的哪一天了。
lines.en: Starting today, I won't buy your days in private anymore.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把发夹拔下来又按回去，推开门，门轴这回没响。
lines.en: She pulls out her hairpin, presses it back in, pushes the door open. This time the hinge doesn't creak.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚推门进来，手空着，镯子在腕上转了半圈。
lines.en: Lydia pushes the door open, hands empty, the bracelet turning halfway around her wrist.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说过下回轮到我带吃的。
lines.en: I said next time it was my turn to bring food.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 结果走到配给站门口，一样都没买成。
lines.en: And then I got to the ration station and didn't buy a single thing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 算了，那不是今天的正事。
lines.en: Never mind. That's not what I came for today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 正事是什么。
lines.en: What did you come for?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 来跟你说一声，恭喜。
lines.en: Came to say congratulations.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 埃莉诺那个脾气，肯先开口，那是真上心了。
lines.en: With Eleanor's temper, if she speaks first, she really means it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你别欺负她。她嘴上厉害，其实挨一句重话能记半年。
lines.en: Don't mess with her. She's all sharp talk, but one harsh word sticks with her for half a year.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 记下了。
lines.en: Noted.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好啊，那我说完了。
lines.en: Good. Then I'm done.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她拉过凳子坐下，背对店主，拨了下镯子，一滴水落在手背。
lines.en: She pulls a stool over and sits, back to the shopkeeper, turns the bracelet, a drop of water lands on the back of her hand.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说完了还坐。
lines.en: Done talking, and you're still sitting.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 腿酸。从上面下来那段台阶太长。
lines.en: Legs ache. That staircase down from up top is too long.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你走过那段台阶。
lines.en: You've walked that staircase.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……对，走过好多回了，今天就是酸。
lines.en: ...Yeah. Walked it plenty of times. Today it just aches.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 莉迪亚。转过来。
lines.en: Lydia. Turn around.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 别看。我妆没画好，丑。
lines.en: Don't look. My makeup's not done. I'm ugly.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你在哭。
lines.en: You're crying.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我没——哎呀，你这人怎么连这个都要说出来。
lines.en: I'm not—oh, come on, do you have to say that out loud too?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 行，我哭了。你满意了？
lines.en: Fine. I'm crying. Happy?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 为什么。
lines.en: Why?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你就说——一个人陪朋友来看人，看着看着，
lines.en: Just tell me—a person comes with a friend to see someone, and while she's watching,

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她自己也看进去了，这算什么？
lines.en: she gets caught up in it herself. What do you call that?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那天你站到打手前面。
lines.en: That day you stood in front of the thug.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还有你把镯子收进抽屉，跟我说别拿去卖。
lines.en: And you put the bracelet in the drawer and told me not to sell it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还有门关上那一天，你什么都没多要。
lines.en: And the day the door closed, you didn't ask for anything more.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我喜欢你。就这么回事。
lines.en: I like you. That's all there is.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 可她先说了。她是我朋友，从小就是。
lines.en: But she said it first. She's my friend. Has been since we were kids.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我不想变成那个从后面挤进来的人。
lines.en: I don't want to be the one who squeezes in from behind.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 所以我退出。今天说完，我就不来了。
lines.en: So I'm backing out. After today, I won't come anymore.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也喜欢你。
lines.en: I like you too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你说什么？不对，等等，你再——
lines.en: ...What did you say? No—wait, say that—

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不行，别再说了，我受不住第二遍。
lines.en: No. Don't say it again. I can't take it twice.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 但这事我一个人定不了。
lines.en: But I can't decide this alone.

blocks.label_en: Ask If She Really Wants to Leave

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你真想退？
lines.en: You really want out?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我想退，又不想。你非要我说这么清楚？
lines.en: I want out. And I don't. Do you have to make me spell it out?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说清楚。
lines.en: Spell it out.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……不想。可我怕她难受。
lines.en: ...I don't. But I'm afraid it'll hurt her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也喜欢你。这事得她在场再说。
lines.en: I like you too. We talk about this when she's here.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主从货架上拿下一袋基础食品，放到她手边。
lines.en: The shopkeeper takes a bag of basic food from the shelf and sets it by her hand.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先吃饭。走不走，吃完再说。
lines.en: Eat first. We'll talk about whether you're going after.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你这人……我哭着呢，你给我这个。
lines.en: You... I'm crying, and you give me this.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也喜欢你。要谈，三个人一起谈。
lines.en: I like you too. If we talk, all three of us talk.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 埃莉诺怎么想，得她自己说。
lines.en: Eleanor has to say what she thinks herself.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你是要我去问她？我替你传话？
lines.en: You want me to go ask her? Be your messenger?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不传话。三个人在一处，当面说。
lines.en: No messages. All three of us, face to face.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 当面……那她要是听完就走呢。
lines.en: Face to face... what if she just leaves after she hears it?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那也是她自己走的。
lines.en: Then she leaves on her own.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你这话也太硬了。
lines.en: That's too harsh.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 可我居然觉得踏实一点。
lines.en: But somehow that makes me feel a little safer.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那天的事，我得先自己跟她说。不许你先开口。
lines.en: I have to tell her about that day myself first. You don't get to bring it up first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好。
lines.en: Okay.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那可说好了，我不退了。暂时。
lines.en: Then it's settled. I'm not backing out. For now.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她擦干脸，别正发夹，推门出去时步子很慢。
lines.en: She wipes her face, fixes her hairpin, and pushes the door open. Her steps are slow.

choices.description_zh: 先把喜欢说出口，但不替埃莉诺决定。
choices.description_en: Say it, without deciding for Eleanor.

choices.label_en: Ask if she really wants to leave
choices.description_zh: 让她把退和不退都说清楚。
choices.description_en: Make her say both sides plainly.
Let her eat before they talk.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 两人一前一后进门，埃莉诺拎着起子布袋，莉迪亚把凳子推到她脚边。
lines.en: The two come in one after the other. Eleanor carries a cloth tool bag, and Lydia pushes a stool to her feet.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 她说有事，非要在你这儿说。
lines.en: She says she has something to say, and it has to be here.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 呵，搞得跟交接货一样。
lines.en: Hah. Like a goods handover.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 是有一笔账，我得先交代清楚。
lines.en: There's an account I need to come clean about first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你修完门以后，我来过。我出了钱，让他关了一天店。
lines.en: After you fixed the door, I came here. I paid him to close the shop for a day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 是我自己的钱。那一天我在这儿。
lines.en: It was my own money. I was here that day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 当时我不知道你先说了，可我也没告诉你。这是我错。
lines.en: I didn't know you'd spoken first. But I didn't tell you either. That's my fault.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺把布袋放到柜台上，盯着袋口的绳子，半天没出声。
lines.en: Eleanor sets the cloth bag on the counter. She stares at the drawstring, silent for a long time.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 一天。
lines.en: One day.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你花钱买他一天不开门。绝了，真像你干得出来的事。
lines.en: You paid him to stay closed for a day. Unbelievable. That's just like you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯。你骂吧。
lines.en: Yeah. Yell at me.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我还没骂。我在想先骂哪句。
lines.en: I haven't yelled yet. I'm deciding which part to start with.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 喂，你也知道这事？
lines.en: Hey, you knew about this too?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 知道。她说要她自己来说。
lines.en: Knew. She said she wanted to tell you herself.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……行吧，这一点算你们俩没糊弄我。
lines.en: ...Fine. I'll say this much: you two didn't lie to me about that.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你们先说。我听着。
lines.en: You two talk first. I'm listening.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主退回柜台后面，把台面上的基础食品袋往旁边推开。
lines.en: The shopkeeper retreats behind the counter and pushes the basic food bags aside.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你倒是会躲。
lines.en: You sure know how to dodge.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这话该你们俩说。
lines.en: That's for you two to say.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我两个都想留。可这得你们俩先说。
lines.en: I want to keep you both. But you two have to talk first.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你先把话撂这儿了，倒省得我猜。
lines.en: You said that up front. Saves me from guessing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那……我先说我的。
lines.en: Then... I'll say my side first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主把凳子推到两人中间，自己回到柜台后面。
lines.en: The shopkeeper pushes a stool between the two of them and goes back behind the counter.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 坐近点就能说开？荒谬。
lines.en: Sitting closer is supposed to make us talk it out? Ridiculous.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 坐近点，你骂我也省点力气。
lines.en: Sit closer. It'll save you energy when you yell at me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我说。我喜欢他，前几天已经跟他讲了。
lines.en: Then I'll talk. I like him. I told him a few days ago.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我本来打算走，不碍你们的事。
lines.en: I was going to leave. Stay out of your way.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你走了，谁陪我挑布料？谁跟我吵价钱？
lines.en: If you leave, who's going to pick fabric with me? Who's going to argue prices with me?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 少来这一套。你一走，我还得天天猜你在想什么。
lines.en: Don't give me that. If you leave, I'll have to guess what you're thinking every day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那你想怎么样。你说，我听。
lines.en: ...Then what do you want? Tell me. I'm listening.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我有三条。
lines.en: I have three rules.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 第一条，我吃醋了会直说，你也一样，不许憋着。
lines.en: One, if I'm jealous, I'll say it straight out. Same for you. No keeping it bottled up.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 第二条，不传话。你有话找我，别绕到他那儿递过来。
lines.en: Two, no passing messages. If you have something to say to me, don't go through him.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 第三条，各人有各人的时间。我的那天你别来插。
lines.en: Three, everyone gets their own time. Don't butt in on my day.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 也别再拿钱去买。
lines.en: And no more paying for things like that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好。三条我都认。
lines.en: Okay. I agree to all three.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我也有要的。
lines.en: Then I've got terms too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我不当顺带的。别让我觉得自己是跟着你过来的那一个。
lines.en: I'm not the tag-along. Don't make me feel like the one who just came along with you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我的那天，我自己跟他约。我不用你让给我。
lines.en: My day, I'll set it up with him myself. I don't need you handing it to me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还有，你哪天要是后悔，当面说，别冷着我。
lines.en: And if you ever regret it, say it to my face. Don't go cold on me.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你倒是挺会提条件。
lines.en: You sure know how to make demands.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你先提的，我跟着学的。
lines.en: You started it. I'm just following.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……行。我点头。
lines.en: ...Fine. I'm nodding.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我也点头。
lines.en: I'm nodding too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我想留下你们两个。
lines.en: I want to keep both of you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这话得三个人都点头才算数。
lines.en: That only counts if all three of us nod.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我刚点过了。你还要我点几回。
lines.en: I just nodded. How many times do you want me to nod.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她点了，我点了。剩你一个。
lines.en: She nodded. I nodded. You're the only one left.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我点头。
lines.en: I'm nodding.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你别笑。我又想哭了。
lines.en: ...Don't laugh. I'm about to cry again.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 哭什么。门修好了还没几天，别把鼻涕抹在柜台上。
lines.en: Cry about what. The door's only been fixed a few days. Don't wipe your snot on the counter.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺从布袋里摸出起子，蹲下去把门轴边一颗螺丝又拧紧半圈。
lines.en: Eleanor digs a screwdriver out of her cloth bag, crouches, and tightens a screw by the hinge another half turn.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我那天是星期几，回头跟你说。
lines.en: I'll tell you later which day I'm taking.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我挑剩下的。不对，等等，我也要先挑。
lines.en: Then I'll take what's left. No, wait, I want to pick first too.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那就各挑各的，撞上了当面吵。
lines.en: Then we each pick our own. If they clash, we fight about it face to face.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好啊，吵就吵。
lines.en: Fine. We'll fight then.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天开门做生意。你们俩坐着别挡道。
lines.en: Opening up today. You two sit down and stay out of the way.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 呵，账我记着。
lines.en: Heh. I'm keeping score.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 门轴转过去，没有响。
lines.en: The hinge swings. No sound.

choices.description_zh: 把位置留给她们两个人。
choices.description_en: Leave the floor to the two of them.

choices.description_zh: 先说自己想留下两个人。
choices.description_en: Say you want to keep them both.

choices.description_zh: 让她们坐近点把话说开。
choices.description_en: Put them close enough to talk.

scenes.title_en: She Looked at You First, Then the Counter

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 原来你长这样。她形容得一点都不准。
lines.en: So this is what you look like. She described you completely wrong.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 想听她怎么说的？不告诉你。说了你要得意。
lines.en: Want to hear what she said? Not telling. You'd get smug.

blocks.label_zh: 主动按实际价值收购：追加

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 东西是真要卖。也想看看，送上门的便宜你占不占。
lines.en: The goods really are for sale. I also wanted to see whether you'd take a bargain that walked in the door.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 试完了。这事你别告诉她，她肯定骂我多事。
lines.en: Done. Don't tell her about this. She'd definitely call me a busybody.

blocks.label_en: After the Trade, Before She Leaves: Added

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她以前出门穿哪条裙子都要先问我。现在连我替她找的工作都不要。
lines.en: She used to ask me which dress to wear before going out. Now she won't even take the job I found her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 算了，这话我自己去跟她说。
lines.en: ...Never mind. I'll tell her that myself.

scenes.title_en: Don't Believe Everything That Mouth Says

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她那个镯子盒上的花纹，我在上层货单里瞧见过。
lines.en: I've seen that pattern on her bracelet box in upper-district catalogs.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那是她家的。上层区卖日用品、香水、布料的几家里，就有他们店铺。
lines.en: It's her family's. They're one of the upper-district houses selling household goods, perfume and fabric.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她从小买东西，店员先问她喜不喜欢。到了你这儿，她想看看没人捧着会怎么样。
lines.en: When she was little, shop assistants asked whether she liked something before she even looked at the price. Here, she wanted to see what happens when no one flatters her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她家做香水和床单生意，管不了法院。她能办的，就是隔三差五跑下来看我。上面那些朋友，也就剩她一个。
lines.en: Her family sells perfume and bedding. They can't influence the courts. All she can do is come down every few days to see me. Of all her friends upstairs, she's the only one left.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 关心是真关心。就是总想替我把路都挑好。
lines.en: She cares. She just always wants to pick the whole road for me.

scenes.title_en: I Can Give You a Hand

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天不拿东西考你了。我是来道谢的。
lines.en: No tests today. I came to say thanks.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她母亲回来以后，她终于肯好好睡一觉。前天我去找她，她居然睡到了中午。
lines.en: After her mother came back, she finally let herself sleep. When I went to see her the day before yesterday, she'd slept until noon.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以前我劝她回上面找熟人把事情摆平。她不听，我还跟她生过气。
lines.en: I used to tell her to go upstairs and ask old connections to fix it. She wouldn't listen, and I got angry with her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她最难的时候，我还在跟她说哪条裙子显精神。……我根本没听懂她在说什么。
lines.en: When she was at her worst, I was still telling her which dress would look more spirited. ...I wasn't hearing a word she said.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我跟她说了。她骂了我两句，然后问我吃饭没有。算是原谅我了吧。
lines.en: I told her. She cursed me out, then asked whether I'd eaten. I suppose that means she forgave me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还有件事。她现在提起你，比提起今天赚了多少还多。我猜多半是在骂你。
lines.en: One more thing. She mentions you more than she mentions today's earnings. I assume most of it is complaining.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她总不能每次见我，都承认自己想你吧。
lines.en: She can't admit she misses you every time she sees me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她要是知道我来了，非掐死我不可。所以我就直说了——你要是真喜欢她，我可以帮你一把。
lines.en: If she knew I came here, she'd kill me. So I'll say it straight: if you really like her, I can give you a hand.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 因为她是我朋友。还因为她每次跟我讲你们聊了什么，最后全是货价！我听着都替你们着急。
lines.en: Because she's my friend. And because every time she tells me what you two talked about, it ends up being about prices! I get anxious just listening.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好！第一条：她要是没急着走，你千万别问“还有什么货”。你就说——今天的发夹真好看。
lines.en: Good! Rule one: if she isn't in a hurry to leave, whatever you do, don't ask 'What else do you have?' Just say—your hair clip looks nice today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 没戴发夹就夸别的！重点不是发夹。你得看着她，别光看柜台。
lines.en: If she's not wearing a hairpin, compliment something else! The hairpin isn't the point. Look at her, not just the counter.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我也就准备了这么几句。都很好用！别笑，用上了再来谢我。
lines.en: That's all I've prepared. They all work! Don't laugh. Thank me after you use them.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 行，我不管了。她要是问起，我就说你今天总算说了句像样的话。
lines.en: Fine, I'll stay out of it. ...But if she asks, I'll say you finally said something decent today.

choices.label_en: Then teach me a few lines.
choices.description_zh: 进入埃莉诺与莉迪亚的三人关系扩展；保留原恋爱资格。上层区声望30／60／90依次推进，获得三件橱窗饰品；不扣声望，未达标可继续经营与日常。
choices.description_en: Enter Eleanor and Lydia's three-way relationship expansion while keeping the original romance requirements. Progress at 30/60/90 Upper Level reputation and earn three showcase ornaments. No reputation is spent; keep trading and receiving visits while waiting.

choices.label_zh: 她的事，我想自己跟她说。
choices.label_en: I want to tell her how I feel myself.
choices.description_zh: 继续原普通恋爱线，不进入本扩展。拒绝不扣好感。
choices.description_en: Continue the original ordinary romance route; this expansion does not begin. Refusal does not lower affection.

scenes.title_en: The Goods Are Settled, But She Hasn't Left

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天就到这里吧。
lines.en: That will do for today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚来过了，是吧？她教你的？
lines.en: Lydia came by, didn't she? Did she teach you that?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 教了几句。留你多坐一会儿，是我自己想的。你今天……气色不错。
lines.en: A few lines. But asking you to stay longer was my own idea. You look... well today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我昨晚只睡了三个钟头。
lines.en: I slept three hours last night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她可真是什么都敢教！……这还差不多。
lines.en: She really will teach you anything! ...That's more like it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我妈嫌我把东西摆得太整齐，她反倒找不着，干脆把我赶出门，让我找点自己的事干。
lines.en: My mother complains I put everything away too neatly and now she can't find anything. She shooed me out and told me to find something of my own to do.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 来卖货！……顺便坐一会儿。
lines.en: To sell goods! ...And to sit for a while.

blocks.label_en: If the Plaque Is in the Showcase

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那块牌子……她连这个都给你了？她碰上喜欢的店，能夸上半天，可真把自己名字摆出去的没几回。
lines.en: That plaque... she gave you that too? She can praise a shop she likes for ages, but she rarely puts her own name out there.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她说要帮你介绍客人。要谢你自己去谢，别什么话都从我这儿绕一圈。
lines.en: She said she'd help you bring in customers. If you want to thank her, do it yourself. Don't route everything through me.

blocks.label_en: If Not Displayed or Not Collected

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她说想帮你介绍客人。她一热心就容易跑在前头。
lines.en: She said she wants to help you find customers. When she gets enthusiastic, she runs ahead.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你能做到哪一步，跟她说清楚就行。
lines.en: Just tell her clearly how far you can go.

scenes.title_zh: 教别人的人，自己没吃饭
scenes.title_en: The One Giving Advice Hasn't Eaten

blocks.label_zh: 共同转入她的个人咨询
blocks.label_en: Together: Turning to Her Own Question

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天不问她了。我自己有件东西拿不准。
lines.en: I'm not asking about her today. I have something of my own I can't decide on.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我看上一枚旧胸针。店主说是名人戴过的，可我就是觉得那几片花瓣好看。多出来的价钱，值吗？
lines.en: I saw an old brooch. The dealer says a famous person wore it, but I just like the petals. Is the extra price worth it?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还在店里，我没付钱。你别笑我买东西只看好不好看。
lines.en: It's still in the shop. I haven't paid. Don't laugh at me for buying things just because they look good.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好看就是理由。谁戴过，让他拿凭据；喜欢花瓣，就按花瓣的价谈。
lines.en: Looking good is a reason. If someone famous wore it, make them show proof. If you like the petals, negotiate the price of the petals.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 所以我不算不懂欣赏，只是不用连那个故事一起买单？
lines.en: So it's not that I don't appreciate it - I just don't have to pay for the story too?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我还以为你会说，这种东西买来有什么用。
lines.en: I thought you'd say this kind of thing is useless.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先吃点正经的。待会儿一块甜点不算午饭。
lines.en: Eat something proper first. A piece of cake later doesn't count as lunch.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我是来教你怎么关心她的，你倒先拿我练上了。好吧，这句我就不转告她了。
lines.en: ...I came to teach you how to care about her, and you practiced on me first. Fine, I won't pass that part on.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你的事也可以拿来问我。
lines.en: You can bring your own problems to me too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说回你。她最烦别人让她猜。真到了要开口的时候，别等她问，也别先想她会不会笑话你。
lines.en: Back to you. She hates being left to guess. When the time comes to speak, don't wait for her to ask, and don't start by worrying she'll laugh at you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你教得倒认真。
lines.en: You're taking this seriously.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我只教到这儿。真见了她，说什么得你自己想。别把我的原话背出来，她一听就知道。
lines.en: I only teach this much. What you say to her, you'll have to come up with yourself. Don't recite my lines—she'll know.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 既然说到胸针——你这儿有没有配得上它的东西？拿出来我看看。
lines.en: Speaking of the brooch—do you have anything here that goes with it? Show me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先看货。价钱照算。
lines.en: Look first. The price is the price.

scenes.title_en: This Line Doesn't Need Her Teaching

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚最近一见我就提你。她说我该听听你怎么说，别总拿货价把话堵回去。
lines.en: Lydia brings you up every time I see her lately. She says I should hear you out instead of shutting you down with prices.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 最近谁见了我都问，接下来打算怎么办。
lines.en: Everyone I see lately asks what I'm going to do next.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把日子过好。找份正经工作，照顾母亲。……有时候，也想来这儿。别让我把每个字都说明白！
lines.en: Live a good life. Find proper work, look after Mother. ...And sometimes, I want to come here. Don't make me spell out every word!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我喜欢你。不想只当你有事才来找的老板。以后也不让你猜。
lines.en: I like you. I don't want to be just the shopkeeper you come to when something's wrong. I won't make you guess anymore.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这句也是她教的？
lines.en: ...Did she teach you that too?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她只教我把话说清楚。喜欢谁，用不着她教。
lines.en: She only taught me to say it clearly. Who I like doesn't need her teaching.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我也是。喜欢你！听清楚了没有？
lines.en: ...Me too. I like you! Did you hear me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我手上还有灰。
lines.en: There's still dust on my hand.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那松开？
lines.en: Should I let go?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 谁让你松了。
lines.en: Who told you to let go?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 知道了。
lines.en: ...I understand.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以后生意照做。别因为话说开了，看见我就躲。
lines.en: We'll keep doing business. Don't start avoiding me just because we've had this talk.

choices.label_zh: （说清楚）我很在乎你，但我们还是做朋友吧。
choices.label_en: (Be clear) I care about you, but let's stay friends.

scenes.title_zh: 三个人的饭，两个人慢慢吃
scenes.title_en: A Meal for Three, Eaten Slowly by Two

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我订了个位置，三个人的。她最近忙得饭都顾不上吃，正好拉她出来。我也去——不然你们俩大眼瞪小眼，谁找话说？
lines.en: I booked a table for three. She's been too busy to eat lately, so I'm dragging her out. Of course I'm coming too—otherwise you two would stare at each other and who'd start the conversation?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这面包是哪位师傅做的？不是我熟悉的那位，我可不买。
lines.en: Which baker made this bread? It's not the one I know, so I'm not buying it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再学一遍，刚才他没听见。
lines.en: Do it again. He missed it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，我还约了人看衣服！你们慢慢吃，不用送。
lines.en: Oh! I promised to look at clothes with someone. Take your time—no need to see me out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你刚才不是说，那家店今天早关门？
lines.en: Did you not just say that shop was closing early today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 还有另一家！总之你们慢慢吃！
lines.en: ...There is another one! Just enjoy yourselves!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 披肩！你又忘了。
lines.en: Your shawl! You forgot it again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 别又光聊货。
lines.en: Do not spend the whole time talking about stock.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她真以为我看不出来。……你那杯往这边放放，摆那儿碍事。
lines.en: She really thinks I can't tell. ...Move your cup this way. It's in the way there.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你们没光聊货吧。我费心腾地方，可不是让你们拿我找乐子的。
lines.en: You two didn't spend the whole time talking about goods afterward, did you? I went to trouble to clear the space. I wasn't doing it for your entertainment.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我这算帮成了。以后她再来跟我抱怨你，我能少听一半就行。
lines.en: I'd say I helped. Next time she complains about you, I only need to hear half of it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她还把披肩递给我。……她一向记得这些。
lines.en: She even handed me my shawl that day. ...She always remembers things like that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 上回那枚胸针，我买了！他拿不出名人凭据，我就按东西本身谈，便宜了不少。配了两条裙子，都好看。
lines.en: I bought that brooch last time! He couldn't prove anyone famous wore it, so I negotiated on the piece itself and got a good discount. It goes with two of my dresses. Both look good.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 也没听你一说就不喜欢了……只是喜欢的时候，不用再担心又当冤大头。
lines.en: It's not that one word from you made me stop liking it... It's just that now I can like it without worrying about being fleeced.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以后我自己的事，也能来问你吧？下回我带自己的难题来，你别嫌烦！
lines.en: From now on, I can ask you about my own things too, right? Next time I'll bring my own problems. Don't get annoyed!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对了，那两条裙子还缺件配的东西。你这儿最近收了什么？
lines.en: By the way, those two dresses still need something to go with them. What have you taken in lately?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 自己看。挑中了再谈价。
lines.en: Look for yourself. We'll talk price if you find something.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那我可记下了。
lines.en: ...I'll hold you to that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 真会煞风景。行吧，先看货。
lines.en: You really know how to kill the mood. Fine, let's look at the stock.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……好。那我先把自己的事想明白。
lines.en: ...Fine. I'll think my own business through first.

choices.label_zh: 可以。别只带难题，想说什么都行。
choices.label_en: Yes. Don't only bring problems—anything you want to say is fine.

choices.label_zh: 可以。先把今天的货看了。
choices.label_en: Sure. Let's look at today's stock first.
Think your own business through first.

scenes.title_en: She Goes Back, and She Comes Back Too

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚帮我打听到一家商行，收日用品和种植设备，缺个整理到货记录、点货的人。
lines.en: Lydia found me a trading house that handles household goods and growing equipment. They need someone to organize delivery records and check stock.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 试了两天。头一天只让我照着单子点货。我挑出一箱型号写错了，他们才肯让我自己记账。
lines.en: I tried it for two days. The first day they only let me count against the list. Then I caught a crate with the wrong model number, and they let me keep the books myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 留下了！雇主在给我办工作通行。先两头跑，熟了再在上面找住处。
lines.en: They did! My employer is arranging a work pass for me. I'll run between both levels for now, and once I know the place better, I'll find a room upstairs.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲留在下面，接着干现在的活。她身上的限制还在。我有了工作，不等于她的事也了结了。
lines.en: Mother stays below, doing the work she has now. Her restrictions are still there. My having a job doesn't mean her case is closed.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 研究那边让我去整理交接记录，有些得在上面做，工作通行单独办。
lines.en: The research office asked me to organize handover records. Some of it has to be done upstairs, with a separate work pass.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我想去。不懂的还多，先把会的做好。莉迪亚帮我问了一间能短住的房间，离那儿不远。
lines.en: I want to go. There's still a lot I don't understand, so I'll do what I can first. Lydia asked about a room I can stay in short-term, not far from there.

blocks.label_en: If the Mother's Case Is Not Withdrawn

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲的复核还没完。她照现在的登记过日子，不会因为我拿到通行，就突然搬上去。
lines.en: Mother's review isn't finished. She lives under her current registration. My getting a pass doesn't mean she'll suddenly move upstairs.

blocks.label_en: If the Mother's Case Is Withdrawn

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲的正式结果也下来了。研究和住处的事，她自己拿主意。我先把我的工作做好。
lines.en: My mother's official result came through too. She'll decide about the research and where to live herself. I'll focus on doing my job well first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 反正这回上去，不再当那个什么都不用管的大小姐。
lines.en: Anyway, this time I'm going up there as someone who doesn't just have everything handled for her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那我可得盼着你下班了。时间提前留出来，你留，我也留。
lines.en: Then I'll have to look forward to you getting off work. Set the time aside in advance. You make time, and so do I.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你怎么不问，我以后还来不来？
lines.en: ...Why have you not asked whether I will still come?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我正想约你。
lines.en: I was about to ask you out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 会来。只是不能每回一想起你，就拎着货跑下来。
lines.en: ...I will. I just cannot run down here with a bag of stock every time I think of you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚还叫我慢慢说，省得你以为我要走了。
lines.en: Lydia even told me to say it slowly, so you wouldn't think I was leaving.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她是不是把我们俩想得太不会说话了？
lines.en: Does she think we're that bad at talking to each other?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 有时候也没想错。
lines.en: ...Sometimes she's not wrong.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我来借你这儿歇歇脚！替首饰店重摆了一上午展柜，腿都站酸了。
lines.en: I'm borrowing your place to rest my feet! I spent all morning rearranging a jewelry shop's display. My legs are sore.

lines.speaker: Lydia
