lines.text: 头一回把最亮的全挤在一起，站远一看什么都看不清。留了点空，连最不起眼的那枚都有人问。老板还想让我下回接着摆。
lines.en: The first time, I packed all the brightest pieces together. From a distance you couldn't see anything. Then I left some space, and even the plainest piece got questions. The owner wants me to do it again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你看这边，花瓣的颜色还不一样。
lines.en: Look here. The petals aren't even the same color.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 正好，把你这儿新收的拿出来我看看。腿歇着，眼睛没歇。
lines.en: Good—show me what you've taken in lately. My legs are resting; my eyes aren't.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看中哪件再说价。
lines.en: Tell me which one you want, then we'll talk price.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这句比夸我会摆柜子好多了。
lines.en: That is much better than praising how I arrange a display.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你今天怎么这么会说话？
lines.en: ...Why are you so good at talking today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你倒是会心疼人。
lines.en: You do know how to be thoughtful.

choices.label_zh: 你替别人忙了一上午，也该有人夸你一句。
choices.label_en: You spent all morning working for someone else. Someone should compliment you too.
Sit down and rest first. The stock won't run away.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 下回你跟她见面，别老问工作顺不顺。她有时候也想让你注意到她新换的发饰。
lines.en: Next time you see her, don't keep asking whether work's going well. Sometimes she wants you to notice her new hair ornament.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你今天也换了。你教的，看人别光看柜台——这招有用。
lines.en: You changed yours too. You taught me to look at the person, not just the counter. It works.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你、你怎么看得这么仔细？我是让你看她！
lines.en: ...You—why are you looking so closely? I told you to look at her!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 谢谢。
lines.en: ...Thank you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那是我送她的！你这眼力，到底是好还是不好？
lines.en: ...I gave her that one! Is your eye for detail good or bad?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不赶。本来想去看新到的裙子，走到半路，又绕到这儿来了。
lines.en: No rush. I meant to go see the new dresses, but halfway there I came around to this place instead.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 裙子又不会长腿跑掉。今天先来看看你有没有学会夸人——看来学得不错。
lines.en: The dresses will not run away. Today I came to see whether you had learned to give a compliment—and it seems you have.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 既然都站到柜台前了，把你新收的东西拿给我看看。别只拿最贵的糊弄我。
lines.en: Since I'm already at the counter, show me what you've recently taken in. Don't fob me off with just the most expensive piece.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看可以。买不买你自己决定。
lines.en: You can look. Whether you buy is up to you.

choices.description_zh: 只改变这次回应，不改变后续关系进程。关系要等三个人各自把话说清楚。
choices.description_en: Changes only this response, not the relationship progression. All three still need to speak for themselves.

choices.label_zh: 埃莉诺好像也有一枚差不多的。
choices.label_en: I think Eleanor has one just like it.
choices.description_zh: 只改变这次回应，不改变后续关系进程。关系要等三个人各自把话说清楚。
choices.description_en: Changes only this response, not the relationship progression. All three still need to speak for themselves.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下周有两天，我能早点下来。我写下来了。
lines.en: There are two days next week when I can come down early. I wrote them down.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上面事情一多，谁都说“就耽误你一会儿”。我不提前留出来，自己的事就总得往后放。
lines.en: When things get busy upstairs, everyone says 'this will only take a moment.' If I don't set time aside in advance, my own plans always get pushed back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那两天，算我们的事。
lines.en: Those two days are ours. Remember that.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚最近来过吗？
lines.en: Has Lydia been by lately?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 前几天来过。就没再来。
lines.en: She came a few days ago. Then she stopped.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她跟我说忙。我提起她一直想去的新店，她连在哪儿都没问，就说约了别人。
lines.en: She says she's busy. I mentioned that new shop she's been wanting to visit. She didn't even ask where it was. Just said she'd made other plans.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她真不想出门时，会嫌鞋磨脚、嫌裙子不合身。不会连地方都没听清就说没空。
lines.en: When she really doesn't want to go out, she complains her shoes pinch or her dress doesn't fit. She wouldn't say she's busy without even hearing where.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她在你这儿，会聊她自己的事吗？
lines.en: Does she talk about her own things when she's here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 会。
lines.en: She does.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以前她跟我说起你，全是“他该这样”“你该那样”。最近一个字都不提了。
lines.en: ...Before, whenever she talked about you, it was all 'he should do this' and 'you should do that.' Lately she doesn't say a word.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我还没想好要问她什么。你也别因为我问这一句，就突然装作不认识她。那样更难看。
lines.en: I haven't decided what to ask her yet. And don't suddenly pretend you don't know her just because I asked. That would look worse.

scenes.title_en: This Time I Really Won't Help

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以后你想约她，直接问她就行。我最近……事情多。
lines.en: From now on, if you want to ask her out, just ask her. I've been... busy lately.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我们已经直接说了。
lines.en: We've already talked directly.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就好。我这件事算办完了。
lines.en: Good. Then my job here is done.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又不是非得天天往这儿绕。上回为了绕过来，连想看的裙子都没去。
lines.en: It's not like I have to come around here every day. Last time I came this way, I missed a dress I wanted to see.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 有别的安排。
lines.en: ...I had other plans later.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不想说就算了，别拿别的事搪塞我。
lines.en: If you don't want to talk about it, fine. Don't fob me off with something else.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我以为事情办成了会很高兴。替她高兴，也替你高兴。
lines.en: I thought I'd be happy once it worked out. Happy for her, and happy for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 就是……她跟我说你们见了面，我第一个想的是你们聊了什么。她没提到我，我又气自己连这个都要在意。
lines.en: It's just... when she told me you'd met, the first thing I thought about was what you talked about. She didn't mention me, and then I was angry at myself for caring.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你别安慰我。你一认真看着我，我就更说不下去了。
lines.en: Don't comfort me. When you look at me seriously, I can't finish a sentence.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 让我自己想想。今天就到这儿吧。
lines.en: Let me think on my own. That's enough for today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 客人的事照常。已经说好的，我都会交代清楚。
lines.en: The customer business stays as usual. Whatever's already arranged, I'll make clear.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我没问客人。你不来的这几天，我总忍不住看门口。
lines.en: I didn't ask about customers. These past few days you didn't come, I kept looking at the door.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我知道。你这么说，我就更不知道该怎么走了。
lines.en: ...I know. Hearing you say that makes it even harder to leave.

scenes.title_zh: 不再借她的名义来找你
scenes.title_en: I Won't Come in Her Name Anymore

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这回我不说路过了。我喜欢你。
lines.en: I'm not saying I was just passing by this time. I like you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那你去说。我一想到她会怎么看我，就一句话也想不好了。
lines.en: ...Then tell her. Every time I think of how she will look at me, I lose all my words.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 真是的……这回居然轮到我等你把话说清楚。说清楚之前，别让我偷偷摸摸地等。我也会自己去找她。
lines.en: Honestly... now it's my turn to wait for you to say it clearly. Until you do, don't make me wait in secret. I'll go see her myself too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 一开始，我只是想让她过得好一点。
lines.en: At first, I just wanted things to go better for her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你还记得我那枚胸针，也肯听我讲那些零碎事。我越来越盼着来，又怕你只问她怎么样了。
lines.en: You remembered my brooch, and you listened to all those little things. I started looking forward to coming here—and then feared you only asked how she was.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 可埃莉诺还不知道。你得把真话都告诉她。你到底怎么想，别让她和我都只能猜。
lines.en: But Eleanor doesn't know yet. You have to tell her the truth. What do you actually want? Don't leave us both guessing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你、你先别这么快回答。听我说完。
lines.en: ...You—don't answer so fast. Hear me out first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好。我没让你今天就决定。
lines.en: All right. I'm not asking you to decide today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我怕说长了，你又要拿货价堵我。
lines.en: I was afraid a longer one would make you shut me down with prices again.

choices.label_zh: 我也喜欢你。可我跟她在一起，不会背着她答应你什么。这件事，我会亲口告诉她。
choices.label_en: I like you too. But I'm with her, and I won't promise you anything behind her back. I'll tell her this myself.
choices.description_zh: 开启三人关系的明确讨论；尚未确立双恋，三人将分别表达意愿。
choices.description_en: Open the explicit three-way discussion; nothing is committed yet.

choices.label_zh: 我不会背着她答应你。我们各自跟她说清楚。
choices.label_en: I won't promise you anything behind her back. We'll each speak to her ourselves.
choices.description_zh: 继续三人讨论；尚未提交双恋。
choices.description_en: Continue the three-way discussion; nothing is committed yet.

choices.label_zh: 我很在意你。让我先把话理清楚。
choices.label_en: I care about you. Let me sort out what to say first.

choices.label_zh: 你连告白都挑最短的说？
choices.label_en: You picked the shortest possible confession?

scenes.title_en: She Wants to Hear It From You

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 莉迪亚说，她喜欢我。我也喜欢她。我不想骗你说只把她当朋友，这件事得我自己告诉你。
lines.en: Lydia says she likes me. I like her too. I don't want to lie and say she's just a friend. I had to tell you myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 然后呢？你还真敢当着我的面说！
lines.en: ...And then? You really dare say it to my face!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我生气！我早就觉得不对劲了。她不来，你也不提。我还以为是我自己多心。
lines.en: Of course I'm angry! ...I've felt something was off for a while. She didn't come, and you didn't mention her. I thought I was imagining things.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我一问起她，你就岔开话——你也知道早该说！
lines.en: Whenever I asked about her, you changed the subject. You knew you should have told me earlier!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你现在想怎么样？跟我分开？
lines.en: So what do you want now? To break up with me?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我想跟你在一起。可也喜欢上了她。这两句话，我都得当面说。
lines.en: I want to be with you. And I have fallen for her too. I owe you both truths, to your face.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你倒是坦白。她呢？她怎么说？
lines.en: ...You're honest, at least. What about her? What did she say?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她说会自己去找你。
lines.en: She said she'd come find you herself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她找我？
lines.en: She'll find me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前两天我还在想，她要是再也不来了，是不是就能当作什么都没发生。我自己想去找她。想问她到底在躲什么……又怕她真说出来。
lines.en: A couple of days ago I was still thinking that if she never came again, maybe I could pretend none of it happened. Then I wanted to go find her myself. To ask what she was hiding... and afraid she'd actually tell me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 三个人吃饭，她拿块面包学别人挑货，我笑得差点把水洒了。她回来拿披肩，我还想叫她坐下。
lines.en: At dinner she held up that bread and imitated a customer. I nearly spilled my water laughing. When she came back for her shawl, I wanted to ask her to sit down again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我也想过，往后还这样一起过晚上。我想要你，也想她留下。……可你别以为，我这就不吃醋了。
lines.en: I have imagined more evenings together like that. I want you, and I want her to stay too. ...Do not think that means I have stopped being jealous.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 等你们谈过，我还在这儿。
lines.en: After you two talk, I'll still be here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先让我跟她谈。我有话要问她，你替不了。
lines.en: Let me talk to her first. I have questions for her that you can't answer for me.

blocks.label_en: One: Wait for Them to Talk

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这几天你别突然不找我。别以为我生气了，你就该躲远点。
lines.en: Don't suddenly stop coming to see me these next few days. Don't think that because I'm angry, you should stay away.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 明天照常开门。你来，就能见到我。
lines.en: I'll open as usual tomorrow. If you come, you'll see me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哼。
lines.en: ...Hmph.

choices.label_zh: 好。等你们谈完。你想问我什么，我都答。
choices.label_en: All right. After you two talk. Whatever you want to ask me, I'll answer.
choices.description_zh: 继续共同关系讨论，尚未登记双恋。
choices.description_en: Continue the joint discussion; the relationship is not registered yet.

choices.label_zh: 我会把答应你们的事做到。
choices.label_en: I will keep my promises to both of you.
choices.description_zh: 明确承担这段关系，继续三方讨论。
choices.description_en: Take responsibility and continue the three-way discussion.

scenes.title_zh: 你教我的话，自己也听一遍
scenes.title_en: Listen to the Line You Taught Me

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我去找她了。……不对，是她先来找的我。
lines.en: I went to find her. ...No, she came to find me first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她一进门就问：“你不是说过，喜欢一个人就别总让他猜吗？”那是我教她的话！她拿来堵我的嘴。
lines.en: The moment she walked in she asked, 'Didn't you say if you like someone, don't make them guess?' That's what I taught her! She used it to shut me up.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说那是说她。她说：“轮到你，就不算数了？”
lines.en: I said that was about her. She said: 'So it doesn't count when it's your turn?'

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说，她要是不想再看见我，我以后就不……话没说完，她就打断我：“你看，又替我把话答了。”
lines.en: I said if she didn't want to see me again, I just wouldn't—before I finished, she cut in: 'See? Answering for me again.'

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以前看你们死活不肯开口，我恨不得替你们说。轮到自己，连第一句该从哪儿说起都不知道。
lines.en: I used to watch you two refuse to open your mouths and want to say it for you. Now it's my turn, and I don't even know where to start.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她问我到底想要什么。我说，我想见你。不是把你送到门口，自己站在外面等。
lines.en: Then she asked what I actually wanted. I said I wanted to see you. Not to walk you to the door and stand outside waiting.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说，她也想我们三个还像那天，说着话就忘了时间。她不会一下子就不介意，也不会每回都把约好的晚上让给我。
lines.en: She said she wants the three of us to be like that day again, talking until we lose track of time. She won't stop minding all at once, and she won't give me every agreed evening either.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说那就各自约。一起去挑东西时，她得陪我逛完，别总惦记着回来见你。
lines.en: I said we'd make separate plans. When we go shopping together, she has to finish the trip with me. Don't keep thinking about coming back to see you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 然后我们俩都哭了。……她不承认，你别问她。
lines.en: Then we both cried. ...She won't admit it. Don't ask her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说下回跟我一起来。我连穿什么都想好了，话却还在脑子里打架。
lines.en: She said she'd come with me next time. I've already thought about what to wear, but the words are still fighting in my head.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我先说一句最要紧的。我想跟你在一起。
lines.en: Then I will say the most important bit first. I want to be with you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也是。
lines.en: Me too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那下回就轮到你了。想清楚再说，别到时候只会一句“都行”。
lines.en: Then it'll be your turn next time. Think before you speak. Don't just sit there saying, 'Whatever you want.'

scenes.title_en: All Three of Us, Saying Everything

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她跟你说我哭了，是吧？她先哭的。
lines.en: She told you I cried, didn't she? She cried first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 手帕明明是我先拿出来的！……算了，今天不跟你争这个。
lines.en: I was the one who got out a handkerchief first! ...Oh, never mind. We can argue about that later.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我想好了。我们三个一起试试。先说好，我吃醋会直接告诉你，别指望我突然变大方。
lines.en: I have thought it over. I want to try this, the three of us. And I will tell you when I am jealous. Do not expect sudden generosity.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你约我的时候，也不许只顾着看她。
lines.en: And when you ask me out, you cannot spend the whole time looking at her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我愿意。……手给我。
lines.en: I want this. ...Give me your hand.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我也愿意。这回别把我落在门口了。
lines.en: I'm willing too. This time don't leave me at the door.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我本来只是来帮个小忙的。
lines.en: I only came to help out a little.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 帮得可真够彻底。
lines.en: You certainly helped thoroughly.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我要收介绍费。一个吻……别当着整家店的面。
lines.en: Then I'm charging a referral fee. One kiss... not in front of the whole shop.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你就不能慢一点？
lines.en: Can't you slow down?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这个嘛，以后你可以教我。
lines.en: Well, you can teach me that later.

choices.label_zh: 如果你们也都愿意，那从今天起，我们三个人认真走下去。
choices.label_en: If you're both willing too, then starting today, let's be serious about this—all three of us.
choices.description_zh: 双方明确同意后提交双恋；不收取任何费用。
choices.description_en: Commit the dual relationship after both explicit agreements; no fee.

scenes.title_en: She Finally Doesn't Need an Excuse

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 忙完没有？我挑了半天衣服，你就看这一眼？
lines.en: Finished yet? I spent ages choosing what to wear, and that is all the attention I get?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天想让我陪你多久？
lines.en: ...How long do you want me to stay today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我想你了。
lines.en: I missed you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天要去哪儿？已经到了。
lines.en: Where are we going today? We're already here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯，专门为这儿挑的。先挑了一条，太像去见长辈；换了这条，又舍不得那条的颜色，在镜子前转了好几圈。
lines.en: Mm. I picked it for this place. I tried one on first, but it looked too much like meeting a relative. Then I changed to this one and couldn't give up the color of the other. I turned in front of the mirror for ages.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 挑得很好。现在不用教了。
lines.en: You chose well. You don't need lessons now.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以前教你夸她，没觉得一句话这么难接。……那你多看一会儿，又不是只给你看进门那一眼。
lines.en: When I was teaching you to compliment her, I never thought one sentence could be so hard to answer. ...Then look a little longer. It's not just for the glance at the door.

blocks.label_en: Replacement Middle Section Without the New Portrait

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 出门前照了好一会儿镜子。你再不说话，我可要自己夸了。
lines.en: I spent a long time in front of the mirror. If you say nothing, I shall have to compliment myself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看见了。今天很好看。
lines.en: I see. You look beautiful today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我还以为得我提醒你呢。
lines.en: ...I thought I'd have to remind you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 再亲一下。
lines.en: ...Kiss me again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 原来真到了这时候，我也没那么会说话。
lines.en: ...So when it actually happens, I'm not that good with words after all.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你还记得我替首饰店摆的展柜吗？老板又找我了，这回我想换个摆法。
lines.en: Do you remember the display I arranged for the jewelry shop? The owner came to me again. I want to try a different layout this time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你跟她也约好了，我知道。今天别老看时间，弄得我随时又要先走。
lines.en: You've made plans with her too. I know. Don't keep checking the time today and making me feel I'll have to leave first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天的时间是你的。
lines.en: Today's time is yours.

choices.label_en: Come here. Let me hold you for a while.
Sit closer. Let's take our time talking today.

scenes.title_en: She Didn't Give Up Her Place

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天是我们约好的。我就想听你说一遍。
lines.en: Today is our agreed time. I just want to hear you say it once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 工作顺。上面的人都知道我哪天要早走。我跟他们说了，是来见你，不用偷偷摸摸。
lines.en: Work's fine. Everyone upstairs knows which day I leave early. I told them I'm coming to see you - no sneaking around.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回是她来陪你的吧。我不问待到几点。有一点吃醋！你别笑，我就是想知道。
lines.en: ...Last time it was her turn to keep you company, right? I won't ask how long. I'm a little jealous! Don't laugh. I just want to know.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你别一见我，就把跟她说过的话全交代一遍，听得我像个来查账的。
lines.en: Don't recite everything you said to her the moment you see me. It makes me feel like I'm here to audit the books.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天就想说一件事——我从上面回来，第一个想见的还是你。别以为多了一个人，我就会少要一点。
lines.en: I only want to say one thing today—when I come back from upstairs, the first person I want to see is still you. Don't think one more person means I'll ask for less.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没打算让你少要。
lines.en: I wasn't planning to ask you to.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就抱紧一点。
lines.en: Then hold me tighter.

scenes.title_zh: 今天不用替我们腾地方
scenes.title_en: You Don't Have to Make Room for Us Today

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天你别再说“随便吃点”。
lines.en: Don't say 'let's just eat something' today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不商量好，总有人忙到最后，拿冷饭当晚饭。
lines.en: If we don't plan it, someone always ends up busy until the food's cold and calls it dinner.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她说的是你，也是她自己。
lines.en: She means you, and herself too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你现在连我的话都替我补全了？
lines.en: Now you're finishing my sentences for me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你以前补得比我多。
lines.en: You used to finish mine more than I do yours.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我就先——
lines.en: Then I'll just—

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 坐下。今天不用替我们腾地方。
lines.en: Sit down. You don't have to make room for us today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又没说要走。上回坐在这儿，到这时候，就该我找借口了。
lines.en: I didn't say I was leaving. It's just... last time I sat here, at this point I'd be finding an excuse.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这回不用找。你那份也留着呢。
lines.en: You don't need one this time. Your portion is still here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我不走了。点心还没吃呢。
lines.en: ...Then I won't go. We haven't had the pastries yet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这点心，不是专门给我们买的吧？
lines.en: This dessert wasn't bought especially for us, was it?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 本来是。今天我也想吃。我本来就会直说，只有喜欢你这件事，练得久了一点。
lines.en: It was at first. Today I wanted some too. I'm usually direct. Only liking you took a little practice.

blocks.label_en: After Dinner, If the Plaque Is Still in the Showcase

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 牌子还摆着呢。生意怎么样，我早就说了，还得看你自己。
lines.en: The plaque is still up. Business, like I said, depends on you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你今天来检查生意？
lines.en: So are you here to inspect the business today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天不查。我想见的人，两个都在。
lines.en: Not today. Both the people I wanted to see are here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 都坐近一点。我可不想隔着桌子看你们。
lines.en: Both of you sit closer. I don't want to look at you across the table.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说得好！往这边挪，我还给你留了点心。
lines.en: Gladly! Move this way. I saved you some dessert.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你再挪，我这边都没地方了。
lines.en: Any closer and there will be no room left on my side.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你还好意思说我？
lines.en: And you have the nerve to say that about me?

blocks.label_en: Plaque Not Displayed or Not Collected

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 给我也尝一口你的。她那份奶油比我的还多。
lines.en: Let me try yours too. Hers has even more cream than mine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 挑了半天，还是惦记别人的。
lines.en: All that choosing, and you still want someone else's.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你刚才还夹走他碗里的菜呢！
lines.en: You just took something from his bowl!

blocks.label_en: Daily 1: The Two of Them Together

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚拎着薄纱披肩趴上窗沿，伸手把你面前的账本推到一边。
lines.en: Lydia drapes her gauzy shawl over the windowsill and leans in, reaching over to push the ledger in front of you aside.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 别算账啦，快帮我评评理，这条是不是比昨天那条更衬裙子？
lines.en: No more number-crunching! Come on, settle a debate for me—does this one flatter my dress better than yesterday's?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 从街口走到这儿你都问三遍了，耳朵都要起茧了。
lines.en: You've asked three times between the street corner and here. My ears are about to grow calluses.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你光敷衍我，我当然得找我们最会看的人当裁判！
lines.en: You just gave me some half-hearted answer, so of course I need our sharpest eye as the judge!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天这条更衬你。
lines.en: Today's suits you better.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 某人的新耳坠也很抢眼。
lines.en: And someone's new earrings are pretty eye-catching too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哇，被你抓到了！她出门前对着镜子比划了好半天呢。
lines.en: Ooh, caught you! She spent ages fussing in front of the mirror before we left.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚你少多嘴……喂，我只是顺手戴上的，好看吗？
lines.en: Lydia, keep your mouth shut— ...hey, I just threw them on. Do they look good?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 都好看，站近点我瞧瞧。
lines.en: You both look good. Come closer, let me see.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺耳尖微热，却顺着你的话和莉迪亚一块儿贴近了窗台。
lines.en: Eleanor's ears go warm, but she follows your lead and leans close to the windowsill beside Lydia.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 靠这么近够了吧……不许敷衍，仔细说说到底哪儿好看。
lines.en: This is close enough, isn't it... No half-hearted answers. Tell me exactly what looks good.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 快夸我！昨晚席上又有人念叨你这儿淘去的旧摆钟了。
lines.en: Come on, praise me! Last night at the banquet, someone was going on again about that old mantel clock they picked up here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说走得比上面新买的还准，听得我尾巴都要翘起来了。
lines.en: Said it keeps better time than the new one upstairs — I nearly wagged my tail clean off listening.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没趁机炫耀是你先发掘的？
lines.en: And you didn't take the chance to brag that you spotted it first?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，我光顾着替你高兴，转头就把抢功的事忘干净了！
lines.en: Oh! I was too busy being happy for you — clean forgot to steal the credit!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那多留一会儿，算替我庆祝。
lines.en: Then stay a while longer. Call it celebrating on my behalf.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚笑吟吟地趴上窗沿，把缀着亮片的耳垂往你眼前凑。
lines.en: Lydia leans over the windowsill with a grin and tips her sequined earlobe toward you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那你先看这个——我今早特意挑的新耳夹，好不好看？
lines.en: Then look at this first — new ear cuffs, picked them out specially this morning. Pretty, aren't they?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 既然看都看了，你把最近收的好货也端出来给我瞧瞧嘛。
lines.en: Well, since you've had your look, bring out your latest haul and let me see too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 光戴一对耳夹多单调呀，总得再配一件才够撑场面。
lines.en: Just a pair of ear cuffs is so plain — I need one more piece to really make a show of it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 自己挑，不过账照算。
lines.en: Pick whatever you like. The bill still stands, though.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 小气鬼！算就算，我今天非把最衬它的那件翻出来不可。
lines.en: Stingy! Fine, charge me — I'm not leaving till I dig out the piece that suits them best.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚让我顺路带个话，她今天有杂事耽搁，得晚点才能过来。
lines.en: Lydia asked me to pass along a message—she got held up with some errands today, so she'll be a bit late.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺手肘支上窗沿，忽然倾身凑近窗口，眼尾弯起得意弧度。
lines.en: Eleanor props her elbow on the windowsill, then suddenly leans in close to the window, the corners of her eyes curving with a smug little arc.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不过她到之前这段空档，全归我一个人。
lines.en: But until she gets here, this whole stretch of free time belongs to me alone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 后半句是我自己加的，你不许划掉，也把手里账本合上。
lines.en: That last part I added myself—no crossing it out, and put that ledger down while you're at it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 趁她不在，偷偷占我便宜？
lines.en: Taking advantage of me while she's away? Sneaky.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 什么叫偷占，我这是先来先得。
lines.en: Taking advantage? Please. This is first come, first served.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她耳尖微热，手指却理直气壮地勾住窗框边缘，半点没退开。
lines.en: The tips of her ears warm slightly, yet her fingers hook over the edge of the window frame with perfect self-assurance, not retreating even a little.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 反正是我先到的，这半个钟头你只能看我，专心陪我说话。
lines.en: Anyway, I got here first, so for the next half hour you can only look at me—and keep your attention on our conversation.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚趴在窗台边托着腮，笑吟吟地用指尖轻点台面。
lines.en: Lydia leans on the windowsill, chin in her hand, and taps the counter lightly with a fingertip, smiling.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 明天我和埃莉诺要出去逛半天，你忙起来可别又忘了按时吃饭。
lines.en: Tomorrow Eleanor and I are heading out for a half-day of shopping. Don't get so busy you forget to eat on time again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上次是谁站在试衣间门口叹气，抱怨我们挑一条裙子挑太久的？
lines.en: And who was it that stood sighing outside the fitting rooms last time, complaining we took forever picking out one dress?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 所以我们商量好了，明天干脆不带你，省得某人又在旁边嫌烦。
lines.en: So we've decided—tomorrow we're simply not bringing you along. Spare someone the grumbling.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那回来记得给我带份点心。
lines.en: Then bring me back a pastry.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好呀，街角新开的那家奶油酥饼，我肯定给你留最大的一盒！
lines.en: Ooh, yes! That new cream pastry shop on the corner—I'll save you the biggest box, promise!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺顺手替你理平袖口折痕，耳尖微红地凑近半步。
lines.en: Eleanor reaches over and smooths a crease from your cuff, ears faintly pink as she leans half a step closer.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 两块酥饼就把你打发了？……还有想吃的现在直说，顺路给你捎。
lines.en: Two pastries and you're satisfied? ...If there's anything else you want, say it now—I'll pick it up on the way.

scenes.title_en: In the Window and in the Shop

blocks.label_en: Daily 5: In the Window and in the Shop

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 刚才巷口有个人绕着我的名字牌直打转。
lines.en: Someone was hovering around my nameplate by the alley entrance just now.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不先看柜台里的货，反倒凑上来问我是不是本人。
lines.en: Didn't even glance at the goods in the case — came right up and asked if I was really me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哦？那我们的大招牌是怎么接招的？
lines.en: Oh? And how did our big attraction handle that?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我大方点点头，顺手就把他的目光引回旧货架上了。
lines.en: I gave him a gracious nod and steered his eyes right back to the vintage shelves.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 来店里不挑东西，光盯着老板娘看像什么话。
lines.en: Coming into a shop and not picking anything out, just staring at the owner — what kind of behavior is that?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 现在越来越会做生意了。
lines.en: You're really getting the hang of this business.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚趴上窗台，故意将缀着碎钻耳夹的右耳往你眼前送了送。
lines.en: Lydia drapes herself over the windowsill and deliberately tilts her right ear — the one with the rhinestone clip — toward you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那当然，我今天在窗前可没少出力。
lines.en: Of course. I've been putting in plenty of work at this window today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 倒是你，这只耳夹我都戴一路了，你光听热闹也没先夸一句。
lines.en: But you — I've been wearing this clip this whole time, and you just enjoyed the show without a single compliment.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 快夸吧，她从刚才起就晃那边的头发，脖子都快酸了。
lines.en: Go on, praise her. She's been flipping her hair on that side so long her neck's about to cramp.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 衬你，刚才一眼就注意到了。
lines.en: It suits you. Noticed it the moment I looked.

blocks.label_en: Daily 6: The Reason to Come Back

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你真该听听，莉迪亚现在回上面都在聊些什么。
lines.en: You really ought to hear what Lydia's been going on about up there lately.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 提起你这铺子里的旧物件，比聊她的新裙子还起劲。
lines.en: She gets more worked up over the old trinkets in your shop than over her new dresses.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，那是因为别人先问起我手上的镯子嘛！
lines.en: Oh, come on—that's only because people kept asking about the bracelet on my wrist!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 是吗？那没人问的时候，又是谁主动提了三次？
lines.en: Is that so? And when nobody asks, who brings it up three times unprompted?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚耳尖微红，轻轻撞了下埃莉诺的肩膀，转头看向窗内的你。
lines.en: Lydia's ears go pink. She bumps Eleanor's shoulder lightly, then turns to look at you through the window.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你好意思说我？每次嘴上说着下来办正事，往窗边一靠就不挪步了。
lines.en: You're one to talk! Every time you come down claiming it's for business, you lean on that window and don't budge.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我那是顺路过来看看货。
lines.en: I come by to check the merchandise. That's all.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天店里清闲，都不急。
lines.en: It's quiet today. No rush on anything.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 两人的目光在窗前碰了一下，埃莉诺指尖轻搭在台沿，神色柔和下来。
lines.en: Their eyes meet by the window. Eleanor rests her fingertips on the counter's edge, her expression softening.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯，别的事早办完了。今天剩下的时间，本来就是留给你的。
lines.en: Mm. Everything else is long since handled. The rest of today was always meant for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那可说好了，整个下午我们都赖在这儿，谁也不许赶人。
lines.en: Then it's settled—we're camped out here all afternoon, and nobody's allowed to shoo us off.

blocks.label_zh: 日常七：一件东西，两种意见

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 窗台边新放了一尊金漆配大红花的旧摆件。
lines.en: A new old ornament has taken up residence on the windowsill — gold lacquer with a big red flower slapped on.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，这金漆配红花也太扎眼了，让我夸好看可夸不出口。
lines.en: Ohh, gold paint and a giant red flower? That's way too loud. I can't even pretend to call it pretty.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 做生意又不是办茶会，放货堆里一眼就能抓人，说不定好卖。
lines.en: Running a shop isn't hosting a tea party. Stuck in the middle of the goods, it grabs the eye — might just sell.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那也不能摆正中间呀，看着跟暴发户的客厅似的！
lines.en: Even so, you can't put it dead center! It looks like some nouveau riche's living room!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 听你的，上次你摆得都有客夸。
lines.en: Your call. Last time you arranged the display, customers complimented it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那当然！快往左挪半寸，借一点侧面的光，对，就放这儿。
lines.en: Of course they did! Now nudge it half an inch left — catch a little side light — yes, right there.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她趴在窗台边指挥，埃莉诺顺手帮着把底座拨正。
lines.en: She leaned over the windowsill calling out directions, and Eleanor obligingly straightened the base for her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……别说，空出半边再借点光，确实比刚塞在一堆里顺眼。
lines.en: ...I'll admit it. Clearing half the space and letting the light hit it — it does look better than jammed in with everything else.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哼，东西俗点没关系，咱们店的排面可绝不能俗。
lines.en: Hmph. Tacky's fine — but our shop's presentation must never be tacky.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她们听我提了几回，都说愿意来看看，还让我带路。我说我亲自看过货，眼光总信得过。她们这才肯往下面走一趟。
lines.en: They heard me mention you a few times and said they'd like to come see the place. They even asked me to show them the way. I said I'd inspected the goods myself, so my judgment should be worth trusting. That's what got them to come down.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 摆橱窗里，别压在本子底下。认识我的人看见，就知道没走错门。
lines.en: Put it in the display window, not under the books. Anyone who knows me will see it and know they came to the right place.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 客人进来以后，看你的本事。我可没答应替你卖。
lines.en: Once customers are inside, that's your part. I never promised to sell for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 上回聚会，她们反过来夸你，说你挑旧货的眼光比上面几家店都准。我差点抢着说，是我先找着你的。
lines.en: At the last gathering they praised you back, saying your eye for old goods is sharper than several shops upstairs. I almost blurted out that I found you first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 先收这个。她们再来挑东西，可就不只带零钱。以前总是我说你好，现在倒轮到我坐在那儿听。……还挺高兴的。
lines.en: Take this first. Next time they come shopping, they won't just bring pocket money. I used to be the one telling them you were good. Now I'm the one sitting there listening. ...I'm happy about it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天竟有人托我，问能不能替她约你看货。以前都是我拉着她们来，现在得先问你哪天有空。
lines.en: Today someone actually asked me to arrange a viewing with you for her. Before, I was the one dragging them here. Now I have to ask which day you're free.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你要来，我总会留时间。
lines.en: There is always time for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说的是客人。这个也给你，摆橱窗里。碰上满意的客人，她们也愿意多留谢意。
lines.en: ...I mean for customers. This one's for you too. Put it in the display. Satisfied customers are more willing to leave a token of thanks.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 真好。以后不用绞尽脑汁，想该带谁来捧场了。
lines.en: Good. No more racking my brain over who to bring to fill the place.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 上回替你收着的东西，我带来了。看看这次放得下没有。
lines.en: I brought what I was keeping for you. See if you have room this time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 牌子摆不摆，你自己决定。我可没打算天天站门口数客人。
lines.en: Whether you put that plaque out is up to you. I am not standing outside counting customers every day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天不查数——我有件自己的事。
lines.en: I'm not here to check the numbers today. I have something of my own.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 快告诉我，上回那顿饭，吃得怎么样？
lines.en: Tell me—how did the rest of that dinner go?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 工作的事还是照先前说的办。别每回见我，都像我要重新去应聘一样。
lines.en: Work is going as we discussed. You do not have to look at me as if I am applying all over again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先前没说清的那件事，今天说清吧。我不想再让我们两个猜了。
lines.en: Let us settle what we left unsaid. I do not want either of us to keep guessing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天真是路过。我在隔壁看了一枚胸针，标价倒比东西还精神。
lines.en: I really was passing by today. I saw a brooch next door with a price rather more impressive than the brooch.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 来问你：石头松了，修好以后值不值得买？
lines.en: I came to ask you: the stone's loose. Is it worth buying after repairs?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先算修理的钱。喜欢也别替卖家付两遍。
lines.en: Count the repair cost first. Liking it is no reason to pay the seller twice.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这话能听。那我先不急着买了。
lines.en: That makes sense. Then I won't rush to buy it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 埃莉诺问，你最近是不是又忙得没吃午饭。
lines.en: Eleanor wants to know whether you have been too busy to eat lunch again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她自己也忙，才让我跑这趟。你以为替你们传话不用走路？
lines.en: She's busy too. That's why she sent me. You think walking over to pass messages is free?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 替我跟她说，我吃过了。
lines.en: Tell her I have eaten.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 真吃过再说。她下回问我你吃的什么，我可编不出来。
lines.en: Tell me that after you've actually eaten. If she asks what you had next time, I can't make it up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我妈今天又问起你。问你店里忙不忙，饭有没有按时吃。她现在倒替你操起心来了。
lines.en: My mother asked about you again today. Whether the shop's busy, whether you're eating on time. Now she's worrying about you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我说我自己来看看。……你先忙，我又没说非要你陪我。
lines.en: I said I'd come and see for myself. ...Go on with your work. I never said you had to entertain me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你们约饭别再挑她工作最忙的时候。她嘴上不说，回去连鞋都懒得脱。
lines.en: Don't schedule meals when she's busiest at work. She won't say it, but she goes home too tired to take off her shoes.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不是替她管你。下回先问她。也别拿最贵的店证明你记住了，找个能坐着吃完的地方。
lines.en: I'm not managing you for her. Next time ask her first. And don't prove you remembered by picking the most expensive place. Find somewhere you can sit and finish the meal.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 记住就行。
lines.en: Just remember that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这件首饰，我最后还是没买。试了三次，每次都想问别人好不好看。一想，我自己都没那么喜欢。
lines.en: I didn't buy that piece in the end. I tried it three times, and every time I wanted to ask someone whether it looked good. Then I thought, I didn't even like it that much.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这回没替谁挑。我自己的东西，总得让我自己点头。
lines.en: This time I didn't pick it for anyone else. My own things have to get my own approval.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 埃莉诺说，店里这阵子还不错。
lines.en: Eleanor says business has been decent lately.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那你先忙。我今天没有要你当场回答的问题。
lines.en: Then carry on. I have no question you need to answer on the spot today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坐一会儿也行。
lines.en: You can sit for a while.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就一会儿。别以为我要替你看店。
lines.en: ...Just a little while. Do not expect me to watch the shop.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 窗框轻响了两下，莉迪亚还没敲完就被埃莉诺按住了手。
lines.en: The window frame rattles twice. Before Lydia can finish knocking, Eleanor catches her hand.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 大清早敲这么响，整条巷子都听见了。
lines.en: Knocking that loud this early? The whole alley can hear you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我这不是怕他还在里面睡懒觉嘛。
lines.en: I was just worried he was still sleeping in.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 少废话，先把这筐旧衣服按厚薄分出来。
lines.en: Enough talk. Sort this basket of old clothes by thickness first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你看看她，对谁说话都这么冲。
lines.en: Look at her. She snaps at everyone like that.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 习惯了。
lines.en: Used to it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （掏出软布）咦，那只旧铜表今天还放在台面上呢。
lines.en: (Takes out a soft cloth) Oh, that old brass watch is still on the counter today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我包里正好有擦镜子的布，替你把表盖擦亮吧？
lines.en: I've got a mirror cloth in my bag. Want me to polish the lid for you?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 别碰。
lines.en: Don't touch it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那是矿上的人押的。
lines.en: Someone from the mine pawned that.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 缝里的灰是井下带出来的。
lines.en: The dust in the seams came up from the shaft.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他留过话，灰没了表就不是他的了。
lines.en: He said if the dust is gone, it isn't his watch anymore.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我出钱替他赎回来，你再托人送还给他好不好？
lines.en: Then I'll pay to redeem it, and you can have someone return it to him. How's that?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 也不用留我的名字，落款就写一位朋友。
lines.en: No need for my name. Just sign it "a friend."

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你连人叫什么住哪层都不知道，落款倒先想好了？
lines.en: You don't know his name or what floor he lives on, but you've already picked a signature?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 收起你那套吧，这下面不缺你顺嘴一提的施舍。
lines.en: Save it. Nobody down here needs your offhand charity.

blocks.label_en: The Pocket Watch — Put the watch away

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先干活吧。
lines.en: Let's get to work.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，你话讲一半怎么又收起来了？
lines.en: Hey, why'd you stop halfway through?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 行行，我先把这筐旧货理完总行了吧。
lines.en: Okay, okay. I'll finish sorting this basket first. Happy?

blocks.label_en: The Pocket Watch — Let her ask

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你问。
lines.en: You ask.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 押表的人……后来还来赎吗？
lines.en: The man who pawned the watch... did he ever come back for it?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他原本就没打算赎。
lines.en: He never meant to.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 当年井上停工，押表换钱撑到复工。
lines.en: The shaft shut down. The watch got him through to reopening.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 复工之后呢，他攒够了钱也没来赎回去吗？
lines.en: And after it reopened? He saved enough and still didn't redeem it?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 每月来一次，只站窗前看一眼。
lines.en: Came once a month. Just stood at the window and looked.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 问灰还在不在，说在就转身走。
lines.en: Asked if the dust was still on it. If yes, he left.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 这种事，我怎么从没听你提过？
lines.en: How have I never heard you mention this?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那他最近这两个月还来过吗？
lines.en: Has he come by these past two months?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 去年冬天后，没再来了。
lines.en: Not since last winter.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那你就把这只表一直留在这儿？
lines.en: So you just keep the watch here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 押单没到期，表就还是他的。
lines.en: The ticket hasn't expired. It's still his.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……是我把事情想得太简单了。
lines.en: ...I made it out to be too simple.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 知道错了就把袖子挽起来，这一筐还没动呢。
lines.en: If you know it, roll up your sleeves. This basket's untouched.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚挽起袖口露出腕上的手镯，低头接过了旧货筐。
lines.en: Lydia rolls up her cuffs, baring the bracelet on her wrist, and takes the basket of old goods.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 放心吧，今天这一筐我肯定理得明明白白。
lines.en: Don't worry, I'll sort this whole basket out properly today.

choices.description_zh: 顺着莉迪亚的好奇，把怀表主人的事讲完。
choices.description_en: Follow Lydia's curiosity and finish the story of the watch's owner.

choices.description_zh: 不把别人的旧事当故事讲。
choices.description_en: Don't tell someone else's old story.

choices.description_zh: 让莉迪亚自己开口问押表的事。
choices.description_en: Let Lydia ask about the pledged watch herself.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你都不知道，刚才吃饭埃莉诺抢着付账，手快得我差点没拦住！
lines.en: You should've seen it—Eleanor grabbed the bill at dinner; she was so fast I almost couldn't stop her!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我不拦着你，你都要把小费押在盘子底下了。
lines.en: If I hadn't stopped you, you'd have left the tip under the plate.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 两个人吃配给餐，你掏三份的钱，生怕旁人不知道你从上面来的？
lines.en: Two people eating ration meals and you pay for three—scared people won't know you're from up above?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，我那不是顺手嘛……再说我也改口得很及时啊。
lines.en: Oh, I was just doing it without thinking... Besides, I corrected myself in time!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对了，我下午突然想起来，还得去另一边办点事。
lines.en: Oh, right—it just hit me this afternoon, I still have something to do on the other side.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你们俩慢慢忙，我就先不在这儿碍事啦。
lines.en: You two take your time. I'll get out of your way.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 站住。下层区哪来的“另一边”？你连路牌都认不全。
lines.en: Stop. What 'other side' is there in the Lower Level? You can't even read all the signs.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚眼神往旁边乱瞟，忽然停在柜台角一只缠着细线的空血袋上。
lines.en: Lydia's eyes darted sideways and suddenly fixed on an empty blood bag at the corner of the counter, tied with fine string.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……咦，这只旧血袋怎么也是押在这儿的？
lines.en: ...Huh? Why is this old blood bag pawned here too?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 封口边上怎么还划了这么一排细道子，整整齐齐的。
lines.en: Why are there all these neat little scratches along the seal?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 一个当妈的押在这儿的。
lines.en: A mother pawned it here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 去配给站后头卖一次血，划一道。
lines.en: One blood sale behind the ration station, one mark.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 记这个做什么？
lines.en: Why keep count?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 怕抽太勤，晕在排队的巷子里。
lines.en: Afraid of fainting in the queue alley from giving too often.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 划满这一边，孩子的药钱就够了。
lines.en: When this side is full, she'll have enough for the child's medicine.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚俯下身，隔着窗沿把那一排浅痕从头数到尾。
lines.en: Lydia bent down and counted the row of faint marks from beginning to end along the window ledge.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 一、二、三……不对呀，这儿还空着三道位置呢。
lines.en: One, two, three... That's not right. There are still three empty spots here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她怎么没划满，就把袋子拿来押给你了？
lines.en: Why did she pawn it to you before filling the row?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先不说了，你忙你的去。
lines.en: Leave it for now. Go do your business.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你这人怎么这样！话讲一半留一半，我哪还走得动道啊！
lines.en: What kind of person are you! Half a story and then nothing—how am I supposed to walk away!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我不管，今天这筐旧货我不理完，你休想赶我走。
lines.en: I don't care. I'm not leaving until I've finished sorting this basket of old goods.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 孩子病好了，用不上了。
lines.en: The child recovered. It's not needed anymore.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 放家里，她夜里总忍不住摸出来数。
lines.en: At home, she can't resist taking it out at night to count.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 押在这儿才睡得踏实。
lines.en: With it pawned here, she can sleep easy.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 上星期她还来买过日用品。
lines.en: She came by last week to buy daily supplies.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……吓死我了，我还当是出了什么不好的事呢。
lines.en: ...You scared me. I thought something bad had happened.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我下午不走了，就在这儿帮你们把剩下的货理完。
lines.en: Then I won't leave this afternoon. I'll stay and help you finish sorting the rest of the goods.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你那“另一边”的事不用办了？
lines.en: So you don't need to take care of that 'other side' business?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，你明明早就看出来我是瞎编的，还非要拆穿我！
lines.en: Oh, you knew all along I was making it up, and you still had to call me out!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 先把你袖口折上去，别又蹭一身灰。
lines.en: Roll up your cuffs first, so you don't get dust all over yourself again.

choices.description_zh: 告诉她血袋后来怎么了。
choices.description_en: Tell her what happened to the blood bag.
Leave the ending on this side of the counter.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 打烊前的柜台角搁着块带灰矿石，木面上留着道浅灰印。
lines.en: Before closing, a dusty chunk of ore sits at the corner of the counter, leaving a faint gray mark on the wood.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这块石头看着挺沉，我能碰一下吗？
lines.en: That stone looks heavy. Can I touch it?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 矿工女儿留下的。
lines.en: A miner's daughter left it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她爹井下挖的头一块。
lines.en: First piece her dad dug up in the shaft.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 成色这么糙，拿到店里也卖不上价吧？
lines.en: Quality's that rough? It wouldn't fetch much in a shop, would it?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 卖不上价，但算个念想。
lines.en: Wouldn't. But it's a keepsake.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她去上层做工带不动。
lines.en: She's going to work on the Upper Level. Couldn't take it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 又舍不得丢。
lines.en: Couldn't throw it out either.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她去了上面做工，那些人会把她当回事吗？
lines.en: She went up there to work. Will those people treat her like she matters?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说不好。
lines.en: Hard to say.

blocks.label_en: The Ore — Tell her not to touch it

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 别碰，人家的。
lines.en: Don't touch. It's someone else's.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好，我就是凑近看看，不乱动人家的东西。
lines.en: Okay, I'm just looking closer. I won't mess with someone else's things.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 拿吧，沾灰。
lines.en: Go ahead. It's dusty.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哇，看着不大，托在手里比我想的沉多了。
lines.en: Wow, it doesn't look big, but it's way heavier in my hand than I thought.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 指腹上全蹭黑了，快拿帕子擦擦吧。
lines.en: Your fingertips are all black. Wipe them with a handkerchief.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 先不擦，留着这点灰也没什么碍事的。
lines.en: Not yet. A little dust doesn't hurt anything.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （嚼）……这味道真够呛，你居然连吃了好几个礼拜？
lines.en: (Chewing) ...This taste is brutal. You actually ate this for weeks straight?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 不止几个礼拜，当时手头紧只能买这个。
lines.en: More than weeks. Money was tight, so this was all I could buy.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我咽得下去，今天肯定一口不剩全吃完。
lines.en: I can get it down. I'm finishing every last bite today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不对呀，你收的钱比埃莉诺跟我提过的少了一截。
lines.en: Wait, you charged me a good bit less than Eleanor said.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 打烊价。
lines.en: Closing price.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你少拿打烊糊弄我，下次来我专挑贵的拿。
lines.en: Don't fob me off with "closing." Next time I'm picking the expensive stuff.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 吃个便宜果子还堵不住你的嘴，快点嚼完走人了。
lines.en: Even a cheap fruit can't shut you up. Hurry, finish chewing and let's go.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 咦，这果子怎么比埃莉诺说的还要贵一点？
lines.en: Huh, why is this fruit a little pricier than Eleanor said?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 谁让你穿得这么体面来买东西，不宰你宰谁。
lines.en: You came shopping dressed that nicely. Who else would he fleece?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 行啊，那我下次换身旧衣服再来窗前买。
lines.en: Fine. Next time I'll come to the window in old clothes.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 怎么把柜台收起来了，连这么便宜的果子都不卖我？
lines.en: Why'd you close up the counter? You won't even sell me a fruit this cheap?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 人家都要打烊落锁了，要试明天再来试。
lines.en: He's locking up for the night. If you want to try it, come back tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我明天一早就过来，亲自挑一个尝尝。
lines.en: Then I'll come first thing tomorrow and pick one out myself.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对了，埃莉诺刚来时天天吃的便宜吃食是哪个？
lines.en: Oh, right. What was the cheap food Eleanor ate every day when she first came?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你问那个干什么，那种干巴巴的果子你咽不下去。
lines.en: Why ask that? You'd never get that dry fruit down.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你能吃得下，我怎么就咽不下去了？
lines.en: If you could eat it, why couldn't I?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 给我拿一份最便宜的，我现在就站在窗前吃。
lines.en: Give me the cheapest one. I'll eat it right here at the window.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 随你，待会儿苦得皱眉头可别找我要水喝。
lines.en: Suit yourself. Just don't come begging me for water when it's so bitter you're scowling.

choices.description_zh: 让她亲手掂一掂那块矿石。
choices.description_en: Let her feel the ore for herself.

choices.label_en: Tell her not to touch it
choices.description_en: Don't touch collateral someone else left.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 一只手背带疤的粗手按住窗台，左耳缺了一块的男人堵在窗口前。
lines.en: A man with a rough, scarred hand pressed on the windowsill and a chunk missing from his left ear blocked the window.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 向你打听个人。
lines.en: I'm looking for information on someone.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 最近总往你这儿跑的那两个上层区女人，平时几点过来、走哪条路？
lines.en: Those two Upper District women who keep coming around—what time do they usually show, and which route do they take?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这儿只做买卖，不打听客人的底细。
lines.en: We only do business here. I don't ask about customers' backgrounds.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 少拿生意话搪塞我，尤其是手腕上戴镯子那个，我盯她两天了。
lines.en: Don't brush me off with shop talk. Especially the one with the bracelet on her wrist—I've had my eye on her for two days.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 上个月那只差点换了主的镯子，被她自己赎回去了吧？
lines.en: That bracelet last month that almost changed hands—she redeemed it herself, didn't she?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 本来出钱想买的那位心里堵着气呢，镯子既然拿不到，就想请她本人过去坐坐。
lines.en: The one who meant to buy it is still stewing. Since he can't get the bracelet, he wants her to come over for a visit.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 上层区家里有的是钱，扣下个人，总比死物更好开价。
lines.en: Upper Level families have money to burn. Detaining a person is easier to price than a dead object.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不买东西就让开窗口。
lines.en: If you're not buying, get away from the window.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 脾气还挺硬，你这破窗口摆的都是些什么玩意儿？
lines.en: Stubborn, huh? What kind of junk are you displaying in this shabby window?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他顺手抓起柜台角那块带矿灰的矿石，在掌心里上下抛着。
lines.en: He grabs the ore from the counter corner, flecked with ore dust, and tosses it up and down in his palm.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 客人的押品，放下。
lines.en: Customer's collateral. Put it down.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 什么戴镯子的女人，没见过。
lines.en: A woman with a bracelet? Never seen her.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 装傻是吧？整条街好几双眼睛看见她们往你这窗口钻。
lines.en: Playing dumb? Plenty of eyes on the street saw them duck into your window.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你要是自己把嘴闭死，待会儿可别怪我们掀了你这摊子。
lines.en: If you keep your mouth sealed, don't blame us when we wreck this stall.

blocks.label_en: Asking Directions — Ask who sent him

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 上个月想买镯子的是谁？
lines.en: Who wanted to buy the bracelet last month?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你不配打听那位的名号，管好你自己的嘴就行。
lines.en: You're not worthy of asking that person's name. Just watch your mouth.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 识相点把那两个女人的去向交出来，还能少受点皮肉苦。
lines.en: Be smart: give us those two women's whereabouts, and you'll save yourself some pain.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 东西放下，马上走人。
lines.en: Put it down and get out. Now.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 那块矿石砸回柜台角，发出一声闷响，恰好停在旧铜怀表旁边。
lines.en: The ore slams back onto the counter corner with a dull thud and stops right beside the old copper pocket watch.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 行，放下了。
lines.en: Fine. It's down.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 不过你这扇挡风玻璃看着挺薄，那块破铜表摆在边上也容易摔。
lines.en: But your window glass looks thin, and that beat-up copper pocket watch at the edge could easily fall.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 为了两个外人把整间铺子搭进去，你算算值不值？
lines.en: Risk your whole shop for two outsiders—ask yourself if it's worth it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 到窗口的都是客，玻璃碎了我自己换。
lines.en: Everyone at the window is a customer. If the glass breaks, I'll replace it myself.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 有种，咱们走着瞧。
lines.en: Got nerve. We'll see about that.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他用指骨重重敲了两下铁窗框，转身混进了巷子暗处。
lines.en: He raps his knuckles hard twice on the iron window frame, then turns and melts into the alley shadows.

choices.description_en: Don't admit the two girls were here.

choices.label_en: Make him drop it and go
choices.description_zh: 把矿石要回来，把人请出去。
choices.description_en: Get the ore back. Show him out.
Find out who's behind it first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天配给站居然没排队，我们走过来省了不少工夫。
lines.en: No line at the ration station today, of all things. Saved us a lot of time getting here.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 先别说那个，你看店主脸色不对劲。
lines.en: Forget that. Look, something's off with the shopkeeper.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 怎么了，是店里出什么事了吗？
lines.en: What's wrong? Did something happen at the shop?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 中午有人来找你。
lines.en: Someone came looking for you at noon.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 找我？我在下层区又不认识什么人。
lines.en: For me? I barely know anyone in the Lower Level.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 问你几点来、走哪条路。
lines.en: Asked what time you come by, which route you take.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 专门提了你手腕上的镯子。
lines.en: Specifically mentioned the bracelet on your wrist.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 是上个月在黑市没买成镯子的那个人？
lines.en: The one who didn't get the bracelet at the black market last month?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那人没咽下这口气。
lines.en: They haven't let it go.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说你家里阔绰，肯花钱赎人。
lines.en: Said your family's rich. Willing to pay ransom.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 荒谬，那家伙居然盘算着绑人向家里勒索！
lines.en: Absurd. That lowlife is plotting to kidnap someone and extort her family!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 而且在他们眼里我也算上面下来的，肯定会一块动手。
lines.en: And to them, I count as someone from up top too. They'll definitely come for us both.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （伸手去撸腕上的手镯）既然是冲它来的，把镯子给他们算了。
lines.en: (Reaches to slip off the bracelet) If it's what they're after, just give it to them.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 别摘。
lines.en: Keep it on.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 冲的是人，不是镯子。
lines.en: They want the person, not the bracelet.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我们现在就去治安部报案，总不能干等着。
lines.en: Then let's report it to the security bureau right now. We can't just sit and wait.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 下层治安部那帮人，没见血根本懒得动笔。
lines.en: The Lower Level security bureau won't even lift a pen unless there's blood.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就报出我家里的姓氏，逼他们把头抬起来管！
lines.en: Then I'll give them my family name and make them sit up and deal with it!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 这倒管用，上面大姓压下来他们不敢糊弄。
lines.en: That'd work. With a big Upper Level name bearing down, they won't dare brush it off.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 中午过来的那个人长什么样？
lines.en: What did the man from noon look like?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 左耳缺一块，手背有疤。
lines.en: Missing a piece of his left ear. Scar on the back of his hand.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 抓了下柜角的矿石又放下了。
lines.en: Picked up the ore on the counter corner, then put it back.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 埃莉诺，要不这两天你先别往这边跑了。
lines.en: Eleanor, maybe you should stay away from here for a few days.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 少来这套，你觉得我是那种会自己躲起来的人吗？
lines.en: Spare me. Do you really think I'm the type to go hide?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我当然知道你不会，那我们就寸步不离一块走。
lines.en: Of course you're not. Then we stick together, every step of the way.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 趁天擦黑前走。
lines.en: Leave before dark.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 绕去配给站人多的路。
lines.en: Take the busy road past the ration station.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我们结伴走大路还好，可你一个人留在店里怎么办？
lines.en: We'll be fine on the main road together, but what about you, alone in the shop?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 店里向来我一个人看。
lines.en: I've always run the shop alone.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你这人真是嘴硬，夜里把窗板早点落锁。
lines.en: You're so stubborn. Lock the shutters early tonight.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚拉下袖口，严严实实遮住腕上的手镯。
lines.en: Lydia pulls down her cuff, completely covering the bracelet on her wrist.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 明天一早我们先去治安部立案，办妥了立刻过来给你信。
lines.en: First thing tomorrow we'll file a report with the Security Bureau, then come straight here to tell you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 明早见，有什么动静都不许瞒着我们。
lines.en: See you tomorrow. Don't you dare hide anything from us.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 路上当心。
lines.en: Be careful out there.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 治安部那帮人太敷衍了，报了家姓也只在簿子上划两行。
lines.en: The Security Bureau was useless. Even after I gave my family name, they just scribbled two lines in a logbook.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 这摞旧衣我塞进底层了，今天干脆早点落锁吧。
lines.en: I've stuffed this pile of old clothes at the bottom. Let's just lock up early today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 等等，巷口怎么突然拐进来三个人？
lines.en: Wait, why did three people just turn into the alley?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 走在中间那个，左耳真的缺了半截！
lines.en: The one in the middle—half his left ear really is missing!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 去配给站那边。
lines.en: Head for the ration station.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 不行，配给站那头的路口也被人堵死了！
lines.en: No, the crossing by the ration station is blocked too!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 他们拎着铁棍冲窗口过来了，你快往后退！
lines.en: They're coming at the window with iron bars. Get back!

blocks.label_zh: 关门前：让她们走巷子另一头
blocks.label_en: Before Closing — The other end of the alley

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 往后巷退。
lines.en: Fall back to the back alley.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 后巷也有脚步声，退不掉了！
lines.en: There are footsteps in the back alley too. We can't fall back!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就贴着窗台别跑了，省得被他们拖进暗处！
lines.en: Then stay by the windowsill and don't run, or they'll drag you into the dark!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 贴着窗台站稳。
lines.en: Hold steady by the windowsill.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （隔窗攥住你的袖口）你别硬拦，他们手里有家伙！
lines.en: (Grabs your sleeve through the window) Don't try to stop them, they're armed!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 铁棍重重砸在卷帘边缘，窗前几格玻璃应声碎裂。
lines.en: An iron bar slams into the shutter's edge, and several panes in front of the window shatter.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你们别过来，我今天压根没戴那只镯子！
lines.en: Stay back! I'm not even wearing that bracelet today!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 货随便拿，人别碰。
lines.en: Take the goods. Leave the people.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他抓莉迪亚的领口了！
lines.en: He's grabbing Lydia by the collar!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我摸到柜角那半瓶香水了，看我不喷死你！
lines.en: I've got that half bottle of perfume from the counter—take this!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 还有这把扳手，给我撒手！
lines.en: And this wrench—let go of her!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 往巷口喊人。
lines.en: Shout toward the alley mouth.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 治安部巡逻队到配给站转角了，在这边！
lines.en: Security Bureau patrol's at the ration station corner—over here!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那家伙捂着眼睛骂人了，另外两个正架着他往后跑！
lines.en: He's clutching his eyes and cursing—the other two are hauling him off!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 跑远了……其实治安部是我瞎编的。
lines.en: They're gone... Actually, I made up the Security Bureau part.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 亏你想得出来，吓得我腿都软了……等等，你袖子怎么全是血？
lines.en: Only you'd think of that. My legs went weak... Wait, why is your sleeve covered in blood?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 皮外伤。
lines.en: Just a scratch.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 什么皮外伤，血都顺着手腕往下滴了，快坐下！
lines.en: A scratch? Blood's dripping down your wrist! Sit down!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （抖着手抓起柜上的旧衣）我给你缠住，怎么越急越扯不开……
lines.en: (Grabs the old clothes on the counter, hands shaking) Let me bind it—why won't this tear when I'm in a hurry...

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 别管旧衣了，直接撕那件灰的！
lines.en: Forget the old clothes, just rip the gray one!

choices.description_en: Reach out to block the attacker.

choices.label_zh: 让她们从巷子另一头走
choices.label_en: Send them down the other end of the alley
choices.description_en: Get them out first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，把左胳膊伸到窗口这儿来。
lines.en: Hey, put your left arm up here at the window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 单手缠的布条歪成什么样了？血又渗出来了都不知道？
lines.en: Look how crooked that bandage is—you wrapped it one-handed. It's bleeding through again and you didn't even notice?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 已经止住了。
lines.en: It's stopped.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少嘴硬！别乱动，我用肥皂水把边上的血痂擦干净。
lines.en: Don't talk tough! Hold still—I'll clean the dried blood off the edges with soapy water.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 换条干净布条重新给你缠紧。
lines.en: Then I'm wrapping it tight with a clean strip.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 昨晚那三个人抡棍子砸窗的时候，你不要命了往前硬挡？
lines.en: Last night, when those three were smashing the window with clubs—you had to stand in front and take it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下次再敢这样莽撞，不等别人动手，我先拿扳手敲醒你。
lines.en: Pull a stunt like that again, and I won't wait for anyone else—I'll knock some sense into you with a wrench myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 听好了！这三天你绝对不准碰重货，明后天我过来替你搬。
lines.en: Listen! Three days, no heavy loads. I'll come by tomorrow and the day after to move things for you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 还有我呢！我特意拎了把扫帚过来扫碎玻璃。
lines.en: And me! I brought a broom specially to sweep up the broken glass.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你们猜我昨晚去治安部怎么着？
lines.en: Guess what I did at the Public Order Department last night?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我直接拍了值班长官的桌子！
lines.en: I slammed the duty officer's desk!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 把我们家的姓氏亮出来之后，我盯着他把案卷写满一整页才走。
lines.en: Once I gave our family name, I stood there until he'd filled a whole page of the case file.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 对了，碎掉的三层窗玻璃算我账上。
lines.en: By the way, the three broken window panes go on my tab.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 还有柜角那半瓶香水，昨晚全喷那几个混蛋脸上了，我照价赔你。
lines.en: And that half bottle of perfume in the corner—I sprayed it all over those bastards' faces last night. I'll pay you for it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 玻璃不用赔，把地扫干净就行。
lines.en: Forget the glass. Just sweep the floor clean.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那可说好了！半点玻璃碴子我都不会给你留下的。
lines.en: Then it's settled! You won't find a single shard left when I'm done.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 哎，等等……碎玻璃堆底下怎么压着块旧铜怀表？
lines.en: Hey, wait... what's this old brass pocket watch doing under the broken glass?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 表盖都摔脱了。
lines.en: The lid's been knocked clean off.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你之前千叮咛万嘱咐过，里面的矿灰一点儿都不能擦，我可记着呢。
lines.en: You made a point of telling me—not one speck of the ore dust inside is to be wiped off. I remember.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 喏，我拿纸全都接住倒回表盖里了，快收进抽屉吧。
lines.en: Here, I caught it all on paper and poured it back into the watch case. Quick, put it in the drawer.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 多谢。昨晚吓着了吧？
lines.en: Thanks. Last night scared you, didn't it?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 怎么没吓着？昨天被揪住领口的时候，我心里怕极了。
lines.en: Of course it did. When I got grabbed by the collar yesterday, I was terrified.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 腿一直在发抖。昨晚回到家里，我连水杯都端不稳。
lines.en: My legs wouldn't stop shaking. Back home last night, I couldn't even hold a cup steady.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 可今天出门前我还是把这只镯子明明白白戴在手腕上了！
lines.en: But before I left today, I put this bracelet right on my wrist for all to see!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 既然是我在乎的地方，谁也别想吓退我，我才不藏着掖着呢。
lines.en: This is a place I care about. No one's scaring me off, and I won't hide it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……算你还有点骨气。不过扫完外面的地你就回上层去吧。
lines.en: ...You've got some backbone after all. But once you've swept outside, go back to the Upper Level.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这儿用不着两个人一直守在窗口。
lines.en: No need for two people to keep watch at the window.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那可不行！你管你的重货，我扫我的地，明后天我也照样来！
lines.en: That won't do! You handle your heavy goods, I'll sweep my floor. I'll be back tomorrow and the day after just the same!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把左胳膊伸出来，我看看布条渗血没有。
lines.en: Stick out your left arm—let me see if that cloth strip is bleeding through.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚今天被家里叫去吃饭了，实在推不掉。
lines.en: Lydia got called home for dinner today—she couldn't get out of it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 伤已经结痂了，箱子我能搬。
lines.en: The wound's scabbed over. I can move the boxes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少逞强，窗底下这箱口粮今天归我清点。
lines.en: Stop acting tough. I'm counting this box of rations under the window today.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺弯腰抱起纸箱，把口粮一包接一包递上柜台。
lines.en: Eleanor bends down, lifts the cardboard box, and hands packet after packet of rations up to the counter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这包封口裂了，卖不出好价，留着你自己吃。
lines.en: This packet's seal is split; it won't fetch a good price. Keep it for yourself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 底下那两件染灰的旧衣还结实，我替你压在箱底了。
lines.en: Those two gray-stained old clothes underneath are still sturdy. I pressed them down at the bottom of the box for you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 歇会儿吧，别累着。
lines.en: Take a break. Don't wear yourself out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 搬几包吃的能有多累，比不上你那天拿胳膊硬挡打手。
lines.en: Moving a few packs of food isn't tiring. Not like you blocking those thugs with your arm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 要不是你横插那一下，莉迪亚早被拖走了，你的手也差点废掉。
lines.en: If you hadn't stepped in, Lydia would've been dragged off, and your hand would've been ruined.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 换药的时候连眉头都不皱，偏要嘴硬说不疼。
lines.en: You don't even frown when the dressing is changed, but you insist it doesn't hurt.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她双手撑住窗沿，指尖抠着木头边缘，声音压低下来。
lines.en: She braces both hands on the windowsill, fingertips digging into the wood, and lowers her voice.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这两天我一直在想那天的事，越想越气。
lines.en: I've been thinking about that day these past two days, and the more I think, the angrier I get.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明明是个精打细算的当铺老板，关键时候怎么那么傻。
lines.en: You're supposed to be a penny-pinching pawnshop owner. How can you be so stupid when it counts?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……算了，本来也没打算一直憋着。
lines.en: ...Forget it. I wasn't planning to keep it bottled up forever anyway.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我喜欢你。
lines.en: I like you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 埃莉诺。
lines.en: Eleanor.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 干嘛突然叫得这么正经，我耳根都烫了。
lines.en: Why call me so seriously all of a sudden? My ears are burning.

blocks.label_en: Moving Goods — Put down your work

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你把刚接过来的口粮轻轻放回柜台，抬眼看向窗外的她。
lines.en: You gently set the rations you just took back on the counter and look up at her outside the window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 看我干什么，我每句话都说得够清楚了。
lines.en: What are you staring at? Every word I said was clear enough.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别光顾着发呆，听见没有？
lines.en: Stop spacing out. Did you hear me?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺扶着窗框猛地往前倾身，隔着窗口飞快在你脸上亲了一下。
lines.en: Eleanor gripped the window frame and lunged forward, stealing a quick kiss on your cheek through the window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不许笑，先把今天这箱货收好！
lines.en: Don't laugh—put today's crate away first!

choices.description_en: Don't interrupt her.
Just her name.

choices.description_zh: 停下手上的事听她说完。
choices.description_en: Stop and hear her out.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 把左胳膊伸过来，你单手系的布条又散了。
lines.en: Give me your left arm. The strip you tied one-handed came loose again.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她隔着窗口低头，替你把松开的纱布重新绕紧。
lines.en: She bends through the window and rewraps your loose bandage tight.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天换了新衣服。
lines.en: New clothes today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哟，我还当你眼里只有货和账本呢。
lines.en: Oh? I thought you only had eyes for stock and the ledger.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 家里那顿饭吃得闷死了，我特意回去换了一身才下楼。
lines.en: Dinner at home was so stifling. I went back to change before coming down.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对了，治安部上午刚给我回过话。
lines.en: Oh, and Security got back to me this morning.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那三个家伙连着几天都没敢在配给站露面。
lines.en: Those three haven't dared show up at the ration station for days.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （深吸一口气）不过我今天过来，其实有件正事要谈。
lines.en: (Takes a deep breath) But I actually came today on serious business.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我想把你整个人买下来。
lines.en: I want to buy you. All of you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你先别笑。
lines.en: ...Don't laugh yet.

blocks.label_en: Name a Price — Ask what she means

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说清楚。
lines.en: Explain.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，你这么看着我，我连第一句从哪儿接都忘了。
lines.en: Oh, with you looking at me like that, I forgot where to even start.

blocks.label_en: Name a Price — Have her sit and talk

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先坐。
lines.en: Sit first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我刚沾了一下凳子就慌，还是站着跟你说吧。
lines.en: The second I touched the stool I got nervous. I'll stand and say it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我不卖。
lines.en: I'm not for sale.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不卖就不卖嘛，那你明天能不能关门歇一天？
lines.en: Fine, fine. Then could you close up for a day tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我出两千信用点，补你明天少做的生意。
lines.en: I'll pay two thousand credits to cover tomorrow's lost business.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 钱哪儿来的？
lines.en: Where'd the money come from?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我自己攒的零花钱，没动家里的账。
lines.en: My own saved-up allowance. I didn't touch the family accounts.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 两千够抵你一天的进账吗，要是不够——
lines.en: Is two thousand enough for a day's earnings? If not—

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不对，我就攒了这么多，按两千算。
lines.en: No, wait, that's all I saved. Two thousand it is.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 刚才那句我从下电梯练到现在，差点拐错巷子。
lines.en: I practiced that line all the way from the elevator. Nearly took the wrong alley.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 明天，早上开门的点。
lines.en: Tomorrow. Opening time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那可说定了，明早我在窗前等你！
lines.en: It's a deal, then! I'll be waiting at the window tomorrow morning!

choices.description_en: Draw the line first.
Make her spell it out.
Get her to sit down first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你怎么现在才把卷帘拉起来呀。
lines.en: Why are you only raising the shutter now?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我在窗前站半天，配给站排队的人都看我好几轮了。
lines.en: I've been standing at the window forever. The ration station line has looked me over several times.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天不做生意。
lines.en: No business today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我当然记得，就是怕你临时反悔才特意抢头一个占住窗口。
lines.en: Of course I remember. I came first to claim the window in case you backed out.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （退开半步背起手）那个……你就没什么想说的？
lines.en: (Steps back half a pace, hands behind her back) So... nothing to say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 衣服虽然还是昨天那身，可发夹我今早对着镜子换了三遍呢。
lines.en: Same clothes as yesterday, but I swapped hairpins three times at the mirror this morning.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 挑来挑去才定下这枚，你快帮我看看合不合适。
lines.en: I finally settled on this one. Quick, tell me if it suits me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你看着她轻轻点了下头。
lines.en: You look at her and nod slightly.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 光点头算怎么回事呀，我想听你亲口说出来。
lines.en: A nod doesn't count. I want to hear you say it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 旁边有人在看。
lines.en: People are watching.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 谁爱看谁看去，我只问你觉得好不好看。
lines.en: Let them watch. I'm only asking if you think it looks nice.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 确实好看。
lines.en: It does look nice.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……哎呀，你答得这么痛快，我反倒不知道接什么词了。
lines.en: ...Oh my, you answered so readily I don't know what to say next.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 昨晚我差点把吃饭的位子都提前订好，后来还是忍住了。
lines.en: Last night I almost booked us a table in advance, but I held back.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 想去哪儿？
lines.en: Where do you want to go?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天全由你定，哪怕就在这儿陪你看一天怀表我都乐意。
lines.en: Today's all yours to decide. I'd happily spend the whole day right here watching the pocket watch with you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 走起来再看。
lines.en: Let's walk and see.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好，老板。
lines.en: Okay, boss.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 窗口的卷帘缓缓落了下去。
lines.en: The window shutter slowly rolled down.

choices.description_en: Answer her directly.
Nod once.
Ask her to keep her voice down.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 昨晚怎么都睡不踏实，索性坐起来把发夹全收进盒子里了。
lines.en: I couldn't sleep properly last night, so I just sat up and put all my hairpins away in their box.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那个……埃莉诺这两天来过你这儿吗？
lines.en: Um... has Eleanor come by these past couple of days?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我刚去敲门，她室友隔着门缝说她不在。
lines.en: I just knocked on her door, and her roommate said through the crack that she wasn't in.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 可她平时哪怕再生气，也从不会拿这种话躲着我。
lines.en: But no matter how angry she gets, she's never hidden from me with an excuse like that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 老板，是不是我最近太闹腾，惹她心烦了？
lines.en: Boss, have I been too noisy lately? Did I get on her nerves?

blocks.label_en: Stop — Have her sit down first

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你先坐下。
lines.en: Sit down first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你这么严肃叫我坐，我心里就更没底了。
lines.en: You telling me to sit so seriously makes me even more nervous.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那天来之前，你想过她吗？
lines.en: Before you came that day, did you think about her?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我本来也没打算一直瞒着她，只是想先跟你要那一天……怎么突然问这个？
lines.en: I wasn't planning to keep it from her forever. I just wanted that one day from you first... Why ask that all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你来开价的前一天，她来过。
lines.en: The day before you came to make your offer, she came by.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她说喜欢我，亲了我一下就走了。
lines.en: She said she liked me, kissed me, and left.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她的指尖猛地从柜台边撤回，一把攥紧了腕上的手镯。
lines.en: Her fingertips jerked back from the counter's edge, and she gripped the bracelet on her wrist.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 前一天……原来她早就抢在我前头了。
lines.en: The day before... So she beat me to it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那你当时……是怎么回她的？
lines.en: Then... how did you answer her?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那是我和她之间的事。
lines.en: That's between her and me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你昨天怎么不早说，亏我还缠着你夸我发夹好看……
lines.en: Why didn't you tell me yesterday? And there I was, pestering you to say my hairpins looked nice...

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……对不起，老板。
lines.en: ...I'm sorry, boss.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 但那两千信用点你不许退我，昨天你确实关了一天门。
lines.en: But you're not refunding those two thousand credits. You really did close up for a whole day yesterday.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 还去找她吗？
lines.en: Still going to find her?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （吸了口气）去啊，当面把话说清楚。
lines.en: (Takes a breath) Of course. I'll talk it out with her face to face.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……就是最好还是她室友来开门。
lines.en: ...I just hope her roommate's the one who opens the door.

choices.label_en: Tell her straight about that day
choices.description_zh: 把埃莉诺先告白的事说出来。
choices.description_en: Say that Eleanor confessed first.
Let her get steady first.
Ask what she thinks first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （她支着窗台，看不清表情）老板，跟你报个喜。
lines.en: (She props herself on the sill; her expression is hard to read.) Boss, good news.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我刚去见过埃莉诺。
lines.en: I went to see Eleanor.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 把那天在外头的事跟她坦白了。
lines.en: I told her about what happened outside that day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （她学着埃莉诺的样子，把下巴往上一扬）她就这么不咸不淡地说了句“知道，你接着讲”。
lines.en: (She lifts her chin in an imitation of Eleanor.) She just said, dry as could be, 'I know. Go on.'

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 后来她跟我说，她亲过你。我听完不知道还能再说什么，只觉得自己该安安静静消失。
lines.en: Then she told me she had kissed you. I did not know what else to say. I just felt I should quietly disappear.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你俩……挺好的。那我走啦。
lines.en: You two… I'm glad. Well, I'll be off.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （人刚背过身，又转回窗口跟前）……
lines.en: (She has just turned away, then turns back to the window.) ...

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 等等，莉迪亚。
lines.en: Lydia.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 女孩肩头颤抖。
lines.en: Her shoulders tremble.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，丢脸死了。（她用手背胡乱抹了抹脸）
lines.en: Ugh, so embarrassing. (She wipes her face hastily with the back of her hand.)

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我，喜欢你。
lines.en: I like you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
